title: Wasn't she beaten to death with sticks? The powerful cousin is so loving
author: Xuanhua Shangdeng
synopsis:
Jiang Sese transmigrated into a grand power-struggle drama, becoming the cannon-fodder cousin who didn't live past three chapters before being beaten to death with sticks.

She was called a distant cousin, but in reality, she had no connection to the Xie household whatsoever.

The original owner: A "love-brained" fool, constantly stirring up trouble, obsessively infatuated with the male lead, and ultimately dying a miserable death.

Looking at the face of a femme fatale in the mirror and thinking of the "beaten to death with sticks" ending in the book, Jiang Sese shivered.
Love-brained? Not a chance! Survival is the priority!

Thus, Jiang Sese quickly formulated the "Salted Fish Survival Guide":
Rule 1: Stay away from the male and female leads, cherish life!

Rule 2: Hug the thickest thigh in the household tightly, the eldest cousin!!

From then on, the atmosphere of the Xie household changed:
The male lead, affectionately: "Cousin Sese..."

Sese (with a look of terror): "I'm just passing by, I'll leave right now!"

The female lead, dripping with "green tea" vibes: "Cousin Sese, are you dissatisfied with me?"

Sese (shaking her head frantically): "No, no!" (Please let me go!)
As for that eldest cousin...

Sese (fawningly handing over tea): "Eldest cousin, you've worked hard! Please, have some tea!"

Sese (sincerely praising): "Eldest cousin, this outfit today really highlights your murderous aura! It looks great!"

The eldest young master of the Xie family looked at this distant cousin who had suddenly stuck to him like a little tail, with clear eyes but seemingly foolish, and a unique way of buttering him up, and fell into deep thought.

~~~
It wasn't until Jiang Sese risked her life to save Xie Yihua that Xie Jue, who usually kept his emotions hidden, finally lost his temper: "Sese, why don't you trust me? If only one of you can live, I will choose you."
Sese was also shocked: Huh? But aren't you a sister-obsessed maniac?

chapters.title: A Bad Woman's Face
chapters.content:
"...That commotion yesterday, tsk tsk, it was truly an eye-opener."

"Exactly, she jumped into that pond so eagerly, hoping for the young prince Chu to play the hero saving the beauty."

"What is the young prince Chu's status? The legitimate son of the Duke's mansion, destined to marry a princess in the future! Her little schemes were clear even to the rough cleaning maids in the mansion."

"Sigh, what a pity for that face..."

"No matter how pretty the face is, without the fate or the judgment for it, it's all in vain. I heard the young prince Chu didn't even blink, just ordered his maid Qingping to go into the water to fish her out. That scene... it was truly embarrassing."

"Indeed, she’s not even considered a proper mistress, just a relative from Concubine Sun's side, yet she still thinks of climbing the social ladder? The Second Madam's face was truly ugly yesterday..."

The low murmurs, carrying a trace of imperceptible contempt and schadenfreude, drifted through the thin gauze window like annoying mosquitoes.

Buzzing into Jiang Sese's ears.

Jiang Sese tossed and turned irritably in the silk quilt. She was done.

Early in the morning, which gossip group is holding a morning meeting next door?

And "Young Prince Chu," "Maid Qingping," "Second Madam"... are they acting out a play?

Wait!

Wait, wait, wait.

Let her be shocked for three seconds!

Why does this script sound so familiar?!!!

Jiang Sese opened her eyes abruptly, her sleepiness flying to the clouds.

This dialogue! These titles! This plot!

Isn't this the opening of the dog-blood power-struggle novel "Phoenix Palace Under Heaven" that she stayed up all night reading last night??!

What, has this novel started filming at her doorstep? Is the production budget so explosive that they can't afford a studio and went straight for immersive on-site filming?

That doesn't make sense either; her apartment is on the thirtieth floor.

Jiang Sese sat up with a start, looking around, carved canopy bed, moon-white gauze curtains, silk quilt embroidered with intertwined lotus flowers... and the faint scent of sandalwood in the air.

An ominous premonition rushed to her crown.

Jiang Sese touched her little heart, carefully moved to the dressing table, and after preparing herself mentally, dared to look at the mother-of-pearl bronze mirror.

The mirror clearly reflected a face.

Hair like clouds, skin whiter than snow, a pair of peach-blossom eyes rippling with water, the corners slightly upturned, naturally carrying a three-point seductive charm.

A delicate nose, full lips, especially that small lip bead, adding a bit of naive cuteness.

But at this moment, this face, which could be called a peerless beauty, was full of horror as if she had seen a ghost.

Upon seeing this face, Jiang Sese instantly matched it with the description in the book. The book described Jiang Sese as incredibly beautiful, with a stunning appearance, as vibrant as a peach blossom in bloom, with a natural seductive bone.

Jiang Sese looked at the face in the mirror, terrified, and jumped up, backing away several steps: "Oh Heavens! Oh Earth! Buddha, Jesus Christ, Allah, and my unpaid bills and the membership I just renewed!!"

"Are you playing with me? I just finished working overtime and read a novel to relax, how did I transmigrate into this cannon-fodder cousin who doesn't live past three chapters?!"

If she had committed a crime, let the police come and arrest her.

Instead of letting her transmigrate into this cannon-fodder supporting character who shared her name, was hell-bent on seeking death, and was ultimately "beaten to death with sticks"; Jiang Sese!

The Jiang Sese written by the author was a seductive, cheap woman; she was pretty, but she didn't know her place and was determined to climb the social ladder, only to end up beaten to death with sticks.

The readers all cheered for it.

Only Jiang Sese, who shared the name with the original owner, felt genuinely sorry for her.

But pity is pity, she absolutely did not want to be this Jiang Sese in the book!

In just this short while.

The memories belonging to the original owner suddenly surged in like a tide.

Just yesterday, in order to climb up to the male lead, the original owner had carefully planned a falling-into-the-water scene, hoping the other party would play the hero saving the beauty so she could latch onto him.

As a result, the noble and cold Young Prince Chu didn't even get his sleeve wet, only sending a martial-arts-trained maid to fish her out.

The original owner not only became the laughingstock of the entire mansion but also completely angered the Second Madam, Wang, who already disliked her.

Jiang Sese covered her face, feeling her cheeks burning.

Not from shame, but from embarrassment for the original owner.

"Embarrassing! Too embarrassing! This is a social death scene!"

Jiang Sese looked at herself in the mirror with heartbreak, "You, looking like a femme fatale who could topple a country, how could your brain be like it was caught in a door? Who is the male lead? He belongs to the female lead. You dare to touch that?"

Thinking of the tragic ending of Jiang Sese in the original book...

Because she was instigated by someone to give a sachet to Young Prince Chu, she was caught by Madam Wang, who used the excuse of "shamelessness, private exchanges, and corrupting the family reputation" to order her to be beaten to death with sticks.

Jiang Sese felt a chill run from the soles of her feet to her crown.

Jiang Sese shivered, as if she could already hear the dull thud of the sticks hitting flesh.

No! Absolutely not!

She doesn't want to die.

She still wants to live for another five hundred years.

Jiang Sese darkened her face, slammed the dressing table, then winced and shook her hand, tearing up as she lamented that ancient furniture was really hard. Boo hoo.

Anyway, it's already like this, she's here, the account is created, now she can only go with it.

Jiang Sese thought about it, and her eyes slowly turned from terror to determination.

The original owner's "love-brained" script must be torn up.

She must now act according to the "Salted Fish Survival Guide," stay away from the male and female leads, and cherish life.

And... hug the thickest golden thigh in the mansion; that legendary high-mountain flower, the eldest cousin whom even the Emperor had to fear by three points!

The book wrote about him, blowing him up to the sky, saying his heart was like a cold pool a thousand feet deep, and his power-struggle schemes were terrifying to gods and ghosts.

If it weren't for the fact that he and the female lead were genuine siblings, Jiang Sese would have thought the author actually wanted to write a forbidden romance.

But the author writing about this eldest cousin wasn't without purpose.

This eldest cousin was a sister-obsessed maniac, doting on the female lead, and whenever the male and female leads quarreled, he was responsible for backing the female lead.

Jiang Sese thought for a moment, took a deep breath, and cheered herself on, "As long as I survive, as long as I hug the big shot's leg tightly, whatever male lead, female lead, or Second Madam, they can all get out of my way."

Jiang Sese sat in front of the mirror, trying to squeeze out a pure, innocent smile that said, "I am harmless, I am well-behaved, I don't want to cause trouble at all."

But the beauty in the mirror had flowing eyes, natural seductiveness, and the smile looked like...

Well, a little fox that had just stolen a chicken and was trying to act innocent.

Jiang Sese: "..."

Jiang Sese's smile froze on her face.

It's really hard for this face of the original owner to pretend to be a white lotus.

Looking at it from any angle, it's the face of a bad woman.

Just as Jiang Sese was pondering the century-old problem of "how to squeeze a white lotus effect out of a femme fatale face" in front of the mirror, a soft announcement came from outside the door: "Cousin, the Fourth Miss is here to see you."

Fourth Miss...

Jiang Sese was startled, her brain turning rapidly. Isn't this the female lead?

Alarm bells rang in Jiang Sese's heart. She quickly smoothed her temples to make herself look more haggard, then ran back to the bed and lay down.

Jiang Sese had just covered herself with the quilt.

The door curtain was lifted, and a mistress and a servant entered.

chapters.title: Her Novel Reading Wasn't in Vain
chapters.content:
Xie Yihua wore a moon-white cloud-brocade dress, spotless, making her figure look like a willow swaying in the wind.

Her skin was white and delicate, like fine mutton-fat jade, glowing even without makeup. Her willow-leaf eyebrows were slender and gentle, and her apricot eyes were moist and clear, carrying a sense of pitiful, pure, and innocent charm as she looked around.

Jiang Sese looked at this face, which could be called a textbook-level "white lotus," and felt genuine envy.

Her inner monologue was scrolling frantically: Ahhhhh, this is the face I want!

Xie Yihua walked to the bed, her gaze falling on Jiang Sese's face, which couldn't hide its beauty even in its haggard state. A faint coldness flashed deep in her eyes, but her expression carried a hint of concern: "Cousin Sese, are you feeling better? Falling into the water yesterday really scared us."

"Thank you for your concern, Cousin," Jiang Sese said, quickly lowering her head, her voice as thin as a mosquito's, carrying a trembling tone of lingering fear, "I'm much better now."

"That's good." Xie Yihua nodded slightly, her tone still gentle, "However, cousin, you should be more cautious in your actions in the future. The lotus pond is deep; what if something really happened? Besides..."

Xie Yihua paused, took Jiang Sese's hand, and said with a difficult expression: "Young Prince Chu is of noble status and values rules the most. What you did yesterday was, after all, somewhat inappropriate."

The maid Hongshao next to her immediately understood and chimed in at the right time, teasing from the side: "Indeed, Cousin, what is Young Prince Chu's status? He is someone destined to marry a princess! You acting like this... if you make the Young Prince unhappy, it might even affect our Xie household..."

Hongshao didn't finish her sentence, just curled her lips.

Xie Yihua immediately frowned, performing a classic scene of a mistress who is deeply attached to her servant but has to reprimand her.

Xie Yihua swept a cold glance at Hongshao and said coldly: "Hongshao, you talk too much. Are the affairs of the masters something a maid like you can discuss? Apologize to our cousin immediately."

Xie Yihua's reprimand was light.

Hongshao understood.

But Hongshao still immediately bowed and obediently apologized to Jiang Sese: "It was this servant who spoke out of turn, please forgive me, Cousin."

The person inside Jiang Sese's heart was already rolling their eyes frantically.

What a good "good cop, bad cop" act; the Oscars owe you both a golden statue!

But on the surface, Jiang Sese instantly became a drama queen.

Jiang Sese suddenly looked up, her eyes slightly red, looking extremely humble and terrified: "No, no, Cousin Yihua, please don't blame Sister Hongshao. Sister Hongshao... Sister Hongshao is telling the truth!"

Jiang Sese's voice was choked with sobs, as if she had been touched in a sore spot, "It was me... it was me who didn't know my place, had delusional thoughts, and caused such a joke yesterday... Sister Hongshao is doing this for my own good, to prevent me from making mistakes again. I should be grateful!"

As Jiang Sese spoke, she pressed a handkerchief to the corner of her eyes.

Although there were no tears.

Xie Yihua looked at Jiang Sese's terrified and humble appearance, and the frustration in her heart dissipated slightly, the corners of her lips curling up imperceptibly.

At least she knows her place.

Xie Yihua continued to lecture Jiang Sese: "Hongshao is just a maid, she's not worth you calling her sister."

Hongshao, standing to the side, immediately lowered her head.

Xie Yihua looked down on Jiang Sese in her heart; after all, she came from a small family, full of petty airs, and couldn't even distinguish between superior and inferior.

But then she heard Jiang Sese change the subject and suddenly say: "Cousin, I dare to disagree with that."

Xie Yihua and Hongshao were both stunned.

Jiang Sese blinked those watery peach-blossom eyes and said seriously: "The Analects say: 'Among three people walking, there must be one who can be my teacher.' Sister Hongshao has been in the mansion for many years, is experienced in human affairs, and has a wide perspective. Her words just now were golden advice that woke me up. In my opinion, anyone who can teach me a lesson, regardless of their status, deserves to be called 'sister'. The Sage also said that education should be for everyone regardless of status; does this 'teaching' depend on status?"

Jiang Sese's speaking speed was not fast, her voice was soft and glutinous, but she quoted the classics, her logic was clear, and her expression was sincere and serious.

Knowledge flashed across Jiang Sese's cerebral cortex, leaving a shallow trace.

Xie Yihua: "..."

Hongshao looked at Jiang Sese with surprise.

She thought this cousin only knew how to sponge off others and climb the social ladder; she didn't expect her to be able to say such things.

But Xie Yihua quickly reacted and smiled: "Cousin Sese is quite good at quoting the classics. The Sage's 'education for everyone regardless of status' is indeed a great truth, referring to the fact that seekers of knowledge should not be divided by status. However... the order of superior and inferior, and the distinction between master and servant, are also the foundation of the Sage's teachings and the rules of etiquette."

"We respect knowledge and teachers, which is only natural. But if this confuses the order of status, wouldn't it be putting the cart before the horse and disrupting the rules? As a maid, it is Hongshao's duty to advise her master; how can she be called a teacher? Your praise, cousin, only makes her feel terrified. Cousin, don't you think so?"

Xie Yihua's words were needles hidden in silk, pointing out Hongshao's duty, defining Jiang Sese's theory of respecting teachers as disrupting the rules, and slapping her with the label of making a servant feel terrified, instantly suppressing Jiang Sese's crooked logic.

Jiang Sese stopped while she was ahead, immediately putting on a look of sudden realization and enlightenment, nodding along: "Yes, yes, Cousin is right, thank you for your guidance."

Jiang Sese's attitude was sincere and her apology was swift, leaving Xie Yihua with nothing more to say.

After lecturing Jiang Sese, Xie Yihua stood up: "It's good that you understand, cousin. You've just recovered, so you need to rest more and think less about useless things. I'll come to see you another day."

After saying this, Xie Yihua turned and left with Hongshao.

It wasn't until the footsteps faded that Jiang Sese let out a long sigh, slumped in her chair, and wiped away the non-existent cold sweat.

Jiang Sese patted her chest and muttered softly: "A soldier is trained for a thousand days to be used for one moment. It’s a good thing my 3000+ hours of novel reading didn't go to waste."

Not long after Xie Yihua and her servant left.

There was another rush of footsteps at the door, mixed with a little maid's urgent cry with a sobbing tone: "Cousin, Cousin! It's not good!"

Jiang Sese had just wanted to lie back down, but upon hearing this, she sat up straight again with a jolt.

What, what is it now?

chapters.title: Going There Would Be of No Use
chapters.content:
As she was thinking, the anxious voice of a young maid came from outside the room: "It’s the Sixth Young Master... the Sixth Young Master, he..."

Jiang Sese’s heart skipped a beat.

The Sixth Young Master... is that Xie Xun?

Although the original owner was a cousin of the Xie family, in reality, she had no true blood relation to them.

The original owner’s father had passed away early, and later her mother died of illness as well. Left with no one to rely on, Jiang Sese remembered she still had an aunt, so she traveled alone to seek refuge with her.

The Xie family consisted of two branches. The second branch was headed by the second master, Xie Bo, who had one wife and one concubine. The wife was Madam Wang, and the concubine was this Concubine Sun.

Jiang Sese’s aunt was none other than this Concubine Sun.

Concubine Sun had one son named Xie Xun, who was just five years old.

"The Sixth Young Master heard that the cousin had fallen into the water and insisted on coming to see her. He ran too fast and, in the hallway... he accidentally bumped into the Fifth Young Lady!" Que'er, who was speaking, stamped her feet in anxiety.

The Fifth Young Lady?

Jiang Sese’s expression in the room tightened.

Madam Wang of the second branch had a son and a daughter: the eldest son, Xie Huaizhang, and the second daughter, Xie Yujiao.

Xie Yujiao was the apple of Madam Wang’s eye, notorious for being arrogant and willful.

Outside, Que'er continued: "The Fifth Young Lady was furious on the spot, saying the Sixth Young Master had no manners and offended his legitimate sister. Right now, she has the matrons holding him down, ready to cane his palms!"

Tears welled up in Que'er’s eyes. "I have no other choice, I can only come and beg the cousin..."

Jiang Sese stood up abruptly to get dressed, a nameless fire rising to her head.

Caning a five-year-old’s palms?

Just because he bumped into her? Xie Yujiao, has your brain been crushed by a door?

I’m afraid the "bumping into her" is just a pretext; using it as an excuse to vent her anger is the real reason.

Although Xie Xun was born to a concubine, he was clever and adorable from a young age, which made him very favored by Xie Bo.

Xie Yujiao naturally held a grudge because of this.

The Xie family was different from other households; they didn't have a tradition of taking concubines. Yet, the second branch’s Master Xie Bo had broken this precedent and, for the first time ever, given Concubine Sun a formal status.

Outside the door, Lü'e looked troubled and whispered: "The cousin has only just recovered, her body is still weak, she really should be resting..."

Another maid, Chuntao, was even more blunt: "Exactly, Que'er, that is the Fifth Young Lady punishing someone... I’m afraid even if the cousin goes, it will be of no use."

The subtext was: Don't you know what status the cousin has? Going there would be a wasted effort.

Upon hearing this, Que'er felt both anxious and angry, and tears finally fell: "But... but the Sixth Young Master is still so young..."

"Who said that if I go, it will be of no use?" Jiang Sese’s voice was not loud.

As the words fell, the door curtain was lifted.

The light from outside flooded in, illuminating Jiang Sese as she stepped out quickly.

Her face still bore the lingering paleness from falling into the water, but her cheeks were flushed with a faint crimson from urgency and mild anger. Far from looking sickly, it added a breathtaking, stunning beauty to her appearance.

Those naturally alluring peach-blossom eyes were now startlingly bright, and as her gaze shifted, the natural charm was tempered with ice, possessing a piercing sharpness.

In her plain clothes and dark hair, her skin looked like snow and her lips like cinnabar; she was the very picture of a stunning, bewitching beauty.

The three maids at the doorway felt a flash of beauty before their eyes and their breath hitched for a moment.

Even Lü'e and Chuntao, who were accustomed to Jiang Sese’s looks, were stunned by this fierce, breathtaking beauty she displayed even while ill.

Que'er was even more dumbfounded, forgetting to cry.

It had only been a few days; how did the cousin become even more beautiful!

Jiang Sese glanced indifferently at Lü'e and Chuntao, and both of them subconsciously lowered their heads.

Only then did Jiang Sese withdraw her gaze and say softly to Que'er, "Lead the way."

Que'er snapped back to reality, as if she had found her backbone. She wiped her tears and said joyfully, "Yes, yes, yes, this way, cousin!"

Jiang Sese stepped forward to follow.

Lü'e and Chuntao looked at each other, hesitated for a moment, and then followed Jiang Sese as well.

Although she was a distant cousin, the Xie family valued their reputation above all else, so they not only took Jiang Sese in but also provided her with two maids.

However, these two maids didn't think much of Jiang Sese.

Usually, they only responded when Jiang Sese gave an order.

Their attitude was completely different from how they treated the legitimate masters.

Everyone knew this cousin was here to sponge off the family, and she wasn't young anymore; she was fifteen this year. She wouldn't be staying in the Xie house for long; sooner or later, she would be married off.

Therefore, Lü'e and Chuntao didn't pay much attention to Jiang Sese.

Along the way, the maids and servants who saw Jiang Sese couldn't help but show looks of astonishment and contempt. Astonishment at the cousin’s stunning looks, with a face like that, she could even be a royal concubine.

Contempt because this cousin was too lacking in self-respect.

Ever since the news spread that Jiang Sese had intentionally fallen into the water yesterday to try and "entrap" the young Marquis Chu, even the servants looked down on her.

Jiang Sese followed Que'er, moving with speed, almost jogging through several corridors.

Just as she turned into the moon gate of the western hallway, she saw a scene that made her blood pressure soar.

Xie Xun’s small face was flushed red, tears welled in his eyes, but he bit his lower lip tightly, refusing to cry out.

His tender, white palms were already red and swollen; clearly, the caning was already over.

Xie Yujiao was lecturing him with an arrogant expression: "You ill-mannered thing, are your eyes growing on top of your head? You offended your legitimate sister; it’s time you learned a lesson. If you dare again..."

"Cousin, you are quite imposing." Jiang Sese spoke up suddenly, interrupting Xie Yujiao.

Xie Yujiao looked up at the sound and met Jiang Sese, who was hurrying toward them.

~~~

chapters.title: Miss Qingshuang? Now I Recognize You
chapters.content:
Jiang Sese wore only a plain outer garment, with a few stray hairs clinging to her cheeks, which were flushed with a faint red from her haste.

In her plain clothes and dark hair, with her snow-white skin and cinnabar lips, her beauty was not diminished; instead, it added a breathtaking, fragile aesthetic.

In contrast, Xie Yujiao was wearing a newly made madder-red dress today, covered in pearls and jade, but her face... could at best be described as delicate.

Placed among a group of maids, she might stand out, but in front of a beauty like Jiang Sese, she was like a sparrow meeting a phoenix, instantly made to look drab and dull.

This sour feeling made Xie Yujiao’s chest tighten, and her original five parts of annoyance instantly rose to twelve.

Although Jiang Sese knew she was currently living under someone else’s roof, walking on thin ice, she could not ignore what happened to Xie Xun.

Xie Xun had bumped into Xie Yujiao only because he was worried about her and was in a hurry to see her.

If Que'er hadn't come to tell her, that would be one thing, but since she knew, she couldn't hide and stay out of it.

Otherwise, if Concubine Sun found out, it would chill her heart.

She had no support in this household; only her aunt, Concubine Sun, treated her with some sincerity. If even Concubine Sun stopped caring about her, she could imagine what her future would be like.

Therefore, even if it were of no use, Jiang Sese had to come.

Jiang Sese’s gaze swept over Xie Xun’s red and swollen little hands. She quickly went over to blow on them and asked softly, "Does it hurt?"

Xie Xun’s eyes were full of tears, and he shook his head.

Only then did Jiang Sese look at Xie Yujiao: "Fifth Cousin, although I have shallow knowledge, I remember that Youxue Qionglin says: 'Brothers should be friendly and younger brothers respectful, this is the order of human relations.' I also heard that elders should be kind and the young respectful. Brother Xun is only five years old, his mind is not yet fully developed. Even if he made a mistake, guidance should come first. As his legitimate sister, instead of showing kindness and teaching him, you use the thunderous power of a cane to punish a young brother. This..."

Jiang Sese paused, letting her gaze linger on Xie Yujiao’s instantly ugly expression. She lowered her eyes, twisting her handkerchief, and said softly: "If this gets out, those who know will say it’s the Fifth Cousin disciplining her brother; those who don't know might think some local bully is here, tormenting the weak."

"You! Jiang Sese, what nonsense are you spouting!" Xie Yujiao was dizzy from being hit with such a heavy accusation of "the big bullying the small." Her face turned from green to white, and the finger she pointed at Jiang Sese was trembling.

"Who is making such a racket here? What kind of decorum is this!"

The Second Madam, Wang, walked over with a dark face, surrounded by a crowd of maids and matrons.

Madam Wang saw Jiang Sese at a glance, and remembering the farce from yesterday, her expression darkened immediately.

Madam Wang had also learned from her maids about Xie Yujiao punishing Xie Xun.

Thinking the beating was already done, she had intended to come over, play the "good person" in front of Xie Xun, and put on a show for everyone by "forgiving" him.

Who would have thought that Jiang Sese would also rush over to stand up for Xie Xun.

"Mother!" Xie Yujiao, as if she had found a backer, immediately complained, "Jiang Sese, she..."

"Shut up!" Madam Wang glared at her daughter, then turned her gaze like a knife toward Jiang Sese. She sneered and said, "I wondered who it was; so it’s the cousin."

"The cousin has only just recovered from her illness, and you’re already out causing trouble? Yesterday’s incident was known to the whole household. I spared you because you were ill. And you? Instead of reflecting on your mistakes, you’re here sowing discord and talking back to your Fifth Cousin? It seems the lesson from yesterday wasn't enough!"

Jiang Sese hadn't expected Madam Wang to be here too.

This was troublesome.

Before Jiang Sese could make up an excuse, Madam Wang’s face sank abruptly, and she said without room for argument: "Someone, take the cousin back and have her copy Admonitions for Women and Internal Training one hundred times each! She is not to step out of her room until she finishes, and she is to reflect on her mistakes!"

Several matrons stepped forward to seize her.

Jiang Sese’s heart sank. She thought, This is bad; Madam Wang is determined to use this as an excuse to deal with me.

She wasn't afraid of copying books, but... her handwriting was ugly.

"Wait a moment."

Just then, a calm and clear voice suddenly rang out.

Everyone looked toward the sound and saw a maid dressed in a pale green vest standing at the entrance of the hallway.

Jiang Sese also looked over with curiosity.

The maid was exceptionally striking, with a well-defined oval face. Unlike the soft, gentle features of ordinary maids, she had a somewhat cold and firm line to her face.

But unfortunately, in the original owner’s memories, there was no information about this maid’s identity.

The maid walked over, bowed neither humbly nor arrogantly to Madam Wang and Xie Yujiao, and said: "Second Madam, Fifth Young Lady, greetings. I am here on the orders of the Eldest Young Master."

Facing this maid, the anger on Madam Wang’s face subsided by more than half, and her eyes twitched slightly: "So it is Miss Qingshuang. I wonder what orders the Eldest Young Master has?"

Miss Qingshuang?!

Now she recognized her.

Jiang Sese reacted quickly. So this was the head maid of Xie Jue from the novel.

No wonder Madam Wang’s attitude was so polite.

Qingshuang smiled slightly and spoke slowly: "The Eldest Young Master just went out and passed by here. Hearing some noise, he ordered me to come and see what was happening. Upon inquiring, I learned that the Fifth Young Lady was teaching the Sixth Young Master about manners. The Eldest Young Master said that the Sixth Young Master is young, and guidance should be based on patience. As for Cousin Jiang..."

Qingshuang paused and looked at the pale-faced Jiang Sese, unable to hide a flash of astonishment in her eyes.

...This cousin is truly too beautiful.

Qingshuang suppressed her thoughts and said: "The Eldest Young Master said, could you please temporarily waive this punishment, Second Madam? It would not be too late to teach her once her health is fully restored."

As soon as Qingshuang finished speaking, everyone present cast looks of extreme surprise.

The Eldest Young Master actually pleaded for Jiang Sese?

Could it be...

Everyone’s gaze fell back onto Jiang Sese’s face.

Even Jiang Sese herself felt a bit uncertain. Could it be that Xie Jue was interested in the original owner?

But in the book, Jiang Sese was beaten to death, and there was no mention of Xie Jue having any reaction.

Others didn't understand Xie Jue’s thoughts, but Qingshuang, as his head maid, naturally knew.

The cousin had just fallen into the water; if she were punished again and ended up dead, the Xie family’s reputation for "mistreating an orphan" would not sound good if it got out.

Seeing the suspicious looks from everyone, Qingshuang smiled and said: "The cousin was frightened by falling into the water yesterday and has not yet recovered. While copying scriptures is meant for reflection, too much of a good thing can be harmful, and I fear it might damage her health."

Once Qingshuang said this, everyone understood.

So that’s how it is.

They were wondering why the Eldest Young Master would speak up for Jiang Sese for no reason.

Although Madam Wang was angry that her punishment of a junior had been rejected in public by the first branch, who was Xie Jue?

He was a powerful official relied upon even by the Emperor, the eldest son of Princess Anning!

Xie Jue’s words in this household were not much different from an imperial decree.

Madam Wang absolutely dared not offend Xie Jue.

Madam Wang looked at Jiang Sese and put on a kind smile: "Since the Eldest Young Master has spoken, then we shall follow his words. Sese, why don't you thank Miss Qingshuang? This time it will be let go, go back and rest well. If you dare to cause trouble again, I will certainly not be lenient!"

"Yes, thank you, Second Madam, for your leniency." Jiang Sese immediately lowered her head and replied, feeling a great sense of relief, a feeling of having survived a disaster.

Seeing that her goal was achieved, Qingshuang bowed again: "Thank you for your understanding, Second Madam. I will take my leave."

Watching Qingshuang turn to leave, Jiang Sese hurriedly called out: "Sister Qingshuang, please wait a moment."

chapters.title: It Wasn't in Vain to Cherish Her
chapters.content:
Qingshuang paused in her tracks and turned back, looking puzzled.

Jiang Sese stepped forward quickly, bowed deeply to Qingshuang, and looked up with eyes full of sincere, post-disaster gratitude: "Please, Sister Qingshuang, convey my thanks to the Eldest Young Master. Many thanks to him for his compassion; Sese is eternally grateful!"

Qingshuang looked at this cousin, a girl of such striking beauty, yet currently appearing so genuinely anxious, and a flicker of surprise, hard to detect, crossed her eyes. She quickly regained her composure, a faint, barely visible smile touching her lips: "You are too kind, Miss. I will certainly pass on your words."

With that, Qingshuang bowed to Jiang Sese once more and turned to leave.

Qingshuang walked through the manor gate and headed straight toward the black-lacquered, flat-topped carriage parked under a locust tree not far away, a vehicle that was understated yet couldn't hide its opulence.

The coachman silently lowered the footstool.

Qingshuang nimbly lifted the curtain and stepped inside.

The interior was spacious and elegantly furnished, covered with thick velvet rugs. In the corner, a small bronze beast incense burner emitted a wisp of crisp cedar scent.

A figure was leaning against the cushions in the main seat, eyes closed in rest.

He was wearing a sky-blue brocade robe with cloud patterns today, a jade belt cinched at his waist, making his posture appear as upright as a bamboo stalk.

The morning light, filtering through the gap in the swaying curtain, cast shifting shadows of light and dark across his face.

Hearing the movement, the man did not open his eyes, merely asking coolly, "Is it settled?"

"Replying to the Young Master, the message has been delivered," Qingshuang said, sitting respectfully in the spot to the man's front-side, her head bowed. "Although the Second Madam was displeased, she ultimately agreed and waived the punishment for Cousin Sese."

The carriage fell silent, save for the rumbling of wheels over the bluestone pavement and the faint crackling from the incense burner.

Qingshuang looked at the man, who appeared so cold and detached from worldly affairs, and remembering the tearful gratitude in Jiang Sese's eyes in the hallway, she hesitated before adding softly, "Young Master, when I was leaving, the cousin specifically called out to me."

The man’s eyelashes flickered imperceptibly, but he still did not open his eyes.

Reading the situation, Qingshuang continued cautiously, "The cousin asked me to be sure to thank you on her behalf; her expression was very sincere and earnest."

A moment later, the man finally opened his eyes slowly.

His eyes were exactly as Qingshuang imagined: deep, calm, and waveless, like a deep lake covered in a thin layer of ice.

The corners of his lips curled upward ever so slightly, a movement so subtle it was less of a smile and more of a knowing, playful amusement.

The man’s thin lips parted, his voice as cold and clear as the striking of jade chimes, revealing neither joy nor anger: "Oh? She has become sensible, then."

In those five short words, it was impossible to tell if it was praise or something else.

Seeing this, Qingshuang immediately fell silent, keeping her eyes fixed on her nose and heart, and said no more.

The carriage rolled steadily forward.

...

Jiang Sese led Xie Xun toward Tinglan Courtyard, where Concubine Sun resided.

Jiang Sese’s two maids, Lü'e and Chuntao, as well as Yunque, who cared for Xie Xun, naturally followed behind.

Lü'e and Chuntao lagged a few steps behind.

Lü'e nudged Chuntao with her elbow, gestured with her chin toward Jiang Sese’s slender back in front, and whispered in a voice so low it was barely audible, "Hey, did you see what just happened? That..."

Chuntao understood immediately, also lowering her voice, her eyes darting around: "Tsk, who would have thought? Although everyone says this cousin is only staying in the manor temporarily, a guest is still a master. Look, even Sister Qingshuang, who serves the Eldest Young Master, stepped in."

Qingshuang’s intervention made the two of them suddenly realize that no matter how hopeless Jiang Sese might seem, she was still, at the very least, half a master.

Lü'e was lost in thought; the two had previously whispered privately about whether they should try to climb higher and serve a more promising master.

Chuntao’s eyes flickered, clearly calculating rapidly: "Let's wait and see... In any case, as long as she is still in the manor, we are still her people."

The two exchanged a tacit look, and their previously restless hearts were temporarily calmed by Qingshuang’s intervention.

...

As soon as Jiang Sese brought Xie Xun inside, Concubine Sun rushed over and hugged him.

She had already heard about what happened.

"Oh, my little ancestor!" Concubine Sun took Xie Xun’s palm, gasping in pain, her voice trembling.

She glanced at Yunque behind them and hurriedly ordered, "Yunque, why haven't you taken the Sixth Young Master to the inner room yet? Use that bottle of white jade muscle-regenerating cream and rub it in carefully, be gentle!"

"Yes!" Yunque replied quickly, carefully taking Xie Xun’s small hand. "Sixth Young Master, please follow me."

Xie Xun looked at Jiang Sese before following Yunque, turning his head back every few steps.

The door curtain fell softly, leaving only Concubine Sun, Jiang Sese, and the two maids, Lü'e and Chuntao, in the room.

The two maids stood a little further away, heads bowed obediently.

Concubine Sun glanced at the two maids, her brow furrowed, then her gaze fell on Jiang Sese, her expression as complex as a tangled knot of thread.

It was truly a face that could steal one’s soul.

Sunlight filtered through the window lattice, casting a thin halo around her, making her skin appear as fair as frost and snow, as delicate as fine mutton-fat jade, yet with a faint, warm, luminous quality.

Her brows were naturally dark without the need for paint, and her eyes were exquisite, the corners naturally curved upward. When she smiled, they rippled like spring water, clear enough to reflect a person’s image, yet hiding a seductive whirlpool in their depths that could inadvertently draw a person’s soul away.

Without the need for rouge, her beauty was already overwhelming.

Even as a woman, Concubine Sun couldn't help but feel a tremor of shock at Jiang Sese’s beauty.

The older her niece grew, the more stunning she became.

If Sese had a good background, such beauty would be a blessing, but with her humble origins, such beauty became a calamity.

Concubine Sun put away the complexity in her eyes and firmly grasped Jiang Sese’s cool wrist: "Sese, you were only just pulled from the water yesterday, your body is still weak. Why did you have to do this? Why provoke that mother and daughter again for Xun’er’s sake?"

Thinking of how the maid had rushed in to report the scene, Concubine Sun’s heart was still pounding.

Madam Wang and Xie Yujiao were both trouble-makers; how could Sese, an orphan living under someone else's roof, dare to confront them head-on?

This child... she was truly loyal and affectionate; it wasn't in vain to cherish her.

Jiang Sese gently squeezed Concubine Sun’s hand back and smiled: "Aunt, what are you saying? Xun’er is my younger brother. He only clashed with the Fifth Young Lady because he came to see me. If I hid and didn't step up, what kind of person would that make me?"

Concubine Sun’s throat tightened, and her eyes reddened: "Good child, it’s been hard on you..."

Originally, Concubine Sun had been hesitant, but because of Jiang Sese’s actions, she decided that if Jiang Sese were willing, she would take the risk to help her...

~~~

chapters.title: Even for a Concubine, One Must Find a Way
chapters.content:
Concubine Sun was just about to speak, but her gaze swept coldly over Lü'e and Chuntao, who were standing to the side.

Jiang Sese understood immediately. Without needing Concubine Sun to speak, she naturally turned her face and said to the two maids: "Lü'e, Chuntao, my aunt is here to look after me. You go wait in the corridor; I will call you if I need anything."

"Yes, Miss." Lü'e and Chuntao exchanged a quick look, bowed obediently, and retreated, closing the door softly behind them.

Only Concubine Sun and Jiang Sese remained in the room.

Concubine Sun then leaned forward, lowered her voice, and said, "Sese, I will only tell you this."

"Yesterday in the study, while I was preparing ink for the Master, I heard him discussing something in secret with someone."

Jiang Sese’s heart skipped a beat, sensing that what was to come was of great importance. She subconsciously sat up straight, holding her breath.

Concubine Sun’s voice dropped even lower: "The princes have all reached marriageable age. Although the Emperor hasn't spoken clearly, the selection of an heir and the choosing of consorts... I fear it is right before us."

Concubine Sun paused, observing Jiang Sese’s reaction, but saw only a calm expression, revealing nothing.

Concubine Sun continued: "Our Xie family is deeply rooted, so naturally, we are involved. The Master’s intention is to choose a suitable match between the Fourth Young Lady and the Fifth Young Lady to marry into the Imperial family!"

Jiang Sese’s pupils contracted imperceptibly.

This was indeed a plot point in the book.

The Xie family eventually decided to marry Xie Yujiao into the Imperial family.

But in the book, Concubine Sun never mentioned this to the original owner at all.

What did it mean that she was telling her now?

Jiang Sese didn't think Concubine Sun had the ability to let her replace Xie Yujiao.

So, Jiang Sese remained silent, listening quietly.

Watching the slight change in Jiang Sese’s expression, Concubine Sun said slowly, "Sese, I know you have high aspirations. But we must face reality. Your background is truly too humble, and with both parents deceased, carrying the label of an orphan, one can never dream of the position of a primary consort."

"However..." Concubine Sun reached out and took Jiang Sese’s cool hand, pleadingly, "With your appearance and talent, being a noble concubine is more than enough. If you are willing, I will make the arrangements. When either the Fourth or Fifth Young Lady marries, you will accompany her as a dowry maid. With that face of yours, why worry about not getting ahead?"

Jiang Sese’s eyes widened slightly; she never expected Concubine Sun to have such an idea.

The original owner had been determined to climb the social ladder.

If she had heard such a "good thing," she would have been overjoyed and agreed on the spot.

But in the original plot, Concubine Sun had never mentioned it.

Jiang Sese remembered.

In the book, because Xie Xun was in such a hurry to see the original owner who had fallen into the water, he clashed with Xie Yujiao and was punished. When the original owner heard this, she coughed a few times and, using her poor health as an excuse, only sent Lü'e to check on the situation.

Had she really changed the plot?

Jiang Sese was both happy and startled.

Seeing Jiang Sese silent, Concubine Sun thought she was unwilling to be a concubine and looked at her with surprise.

Concubine Sun had observed her niece’s behavior since she entered the manor, and at first, she had intended to help Jiang Sese plan her future well.

Who would have thought that this niece, because of her beauty, would develop the unrealistic idea of wanting to climb up to the Duke of Chu?

It had terrified Concubine Sun.

Who was the Duke of Chu? He was a match even for a princess.

And what was Jiang Sese’s status?

Even to become a concubine, one had to find the right connections.

Knowing that Jiang Sese had high aspirations and was determined to find someone of extraordinary status, Concubine Sun had given up on that idea. She could have helped Jiang Sese find a good family, even as the primary wife of a scholar, that would have been easy.

But Jiang Sese’s requirements were too high.

So high that Concubine Sun felt her niece was being delusional.

Concubine Sun had been convinced that Jiang Sese was someone desperate to climb the ladder, so she never expected that when it came to this matter, she would be unwilling?

To others, being a concubine might not be a good thing.

But for someone like Jiang Sese, who had no background and only beauty, it was a great opportunity.

Seeing Jiang Sese silent, Concubine Sun felt a stir in her heart and actually thought more highly of her: "Good child, in the past, I misjudged you. I thought you... I didn't expect you to be..."

Jiang Sese finally came back to her senses, looking at Concubine Sun with confusion.

Concubine Sun analyzed gently: "Although it is a concubine position, you would be serving the Imperial family. As long as that person rises in the future, your status will naturally rise with him. When that time comes, you will be a proper lady..."

"Aunt!" Jiang Sese hurriedly interrupted her.

A grateful smile appeared on Jiang Sese’s face: "Aunt, what are you saying? Sese knows that you are planning for me in every way. I am deeply touched by your kindness."

Jiang Sese lowered her eyes obediently, her long eyelashes masking the thoughts swirling in her mind. Her voice was soft and gentle, carrying just the right amount of confusion and reliance: "Sese is just feeling anxious. I wonder... which prince the Second Master favors?"

Seeing Jiang Sese so sensible, Concubine Sun smiled with satisfaction, patted the back of her hand, and said, "I knew you were a bright child. It seems the Master has his eye on the Third Prince."

The Third Prince?

The name exploded in her mind like a thunderclap, instantly drowning out all other sounds.

The one the Xie family had their eye on was actually the Third Prince from the book, the one who appeared as gentle as jade but was actually deeply calculating, and whose story ended in tragedy.

chapters.title: Giving Her a Push
chapters.content:
In the book, Xie Yujiao married the Second Prince.

The one who eventually ascended the throne was also the Second Prince.

However, Xie Yujiao did not rise in status along with him; instead, she was murdered.

Originally, the target was supposed to be Xie Yihua, but Xie Yihua, protected by the "female lead halo," escaped unscathed. Xie Yujiao was mistaken for Xie Yihua, abducted, and humiliated.

Upon learning the identity of the true culprit, the eldest young master of the Xie family devised a vicious scheme, ensuring that the culprit’s entire clan was wiped out.

Jiang Sese lowered her eyes, lost in thought.

A moment later, she looked up, her gaze clear yet carrying a hint of perfectly measured concern: "It is kind of you, Aunt, to consider everything so thoroughly for Sese. I will remember this gesture."

Then, Jiang Sese changed the subject: "But precisely because of that, I cannot bring harm upon you, Aunt."

The eager smile on Concubine Sun’s face froze instantly, her eyes filled with bewilderment: "What do you mean by that?"

Jiang Sese sat up straight, meeting Concubine Sun’s gaze frankly, and said slowly: "Aunt, the Xie family intends to marry off the Fourth or Fifth Miss into the Imperial family, but I am surnamed Jiang, not Xie."

"If I were to accompany them as a dowry maid into the Prince’s manor, how would the Xie family view this? How would they look at you, Aunt? They would surely think you had ulterior motives, trying to plant an outsider like me to compete for the favor of the Xie family’s legitimate daughters, to dilute their status, or even..."

Jiang Sese pursed her lips and said softly: "They might think you are using me to further your own interests and those of Xun-ge’er."

Hearing this, Concubine Sun broke out in a cold sweat!

She had only thought of this as a wonderful path for Jiang Sese and a way to gain face for herself, worrying only about how to broach the subject with Xie Bo, but she had never considered this angle.

Indeed!

What would the Xie family think?

How would they view her, a concubine who was restless and trying to disrupt the family’s plans using her own niece?

The First Madam, Wang, would be the first to not let her off!

No matter how much Xie Bo favored her, he would never tolerate such overstepping by a concubine!

The more Concubine Sun thought about it, the more terrified she became. Her fingers unconsciously tightened around her handkerchief, her knuckles turning white.

This wasn't helping Sese; it was digging her own grave. If someone with ill intentions used this against her, her already precarious position in the Xie manor would vanish in an instant.

A moment later, the look in Concubine Sun’s eyes toward Jiang Sese changed completely, filled with surprise and lingering fear, followed by a surge of deep gratitude and affection.

This child!

Though she had always seemed a bit proud, she never expected her to be this sharp and perceptive.

Even more rare was that she was thinking of her aunt at every turn. She had previously misunderstood her as being arrogant and whimsical; that was... truly inexcusable!

Still shaken, Concubine Sun hurriedly grabbed Jiang Sese’s hands, her voice filled with the relief of one who had narrowly escaped disaster: "Sese... my good Sese, it was Aunt who was muddled and failed to see this! I almost... almost made a grave mistake!"

Jiang Sese gently held Concubine Sun’s hands in return, patting the back of her hand soothingly, and said warmly: "Aunt only had my best interests at heart. But in this deep, complex Xie manor, one wrong move affects everything. I do not wish to implicate you and Xun-ge’er for my own selfish reasons."

"Good child, I didn't dote on you in vain."

Concubine Sun nodded repeatedly, looking at Jiang Sese with unprecedented tenderness: "It was Aunt who thought wrong! Don't worry, we won't pursue this path to wealth. In the future, I will plan carefully for you and find you a truly reliable husband who will make you a proper, respected wife. I will never let you be wronged!"

Concubine Sun secretly vowed to find a good home for this sensible and clever niece.

Jiang Sese was waiting for these words. Hearing them, she lowered her head slightly, two shy blushes appearing on her cheeks: "Sese... will leave everything to you, Aunt."

Returning to her own quarters after a meal, Jiang Sese lay down, her mind beginning to recall Xie Jue’s preferences from the book.

Initially, she had been hesitant about whether to approach this eldest cousin.

After all, the Xie Jue in the book was no saint.

He was ruthlessly indifferent to everyone, except for his protectiveness toward his own.

He was also a notorious "sister-obsessed" maniac.

But Jiang Sese was not a Xie; it would likely be difficult to curry favor with him.

However, seeing how even the maids around Xie Jue could make Madam Wang smile today, Jiang Sese couldn't help but want to "hug the thigh" of power.

Though it wouldn't be easy, she could at least try.

...

That night, Xie Yihua tossed and turned in bed, unable to sleep.

The stunning face she had seen during the day kept appearing before her eyes like a brand.

Those clear, shy, yet alluring eyes, that porcelain-like skin, that unintentionally fragile yet captivating demeanor...

Xie Yihua turned over again, feeling restless.

"Miss?" A vigilant and soft inquiry came from the outer room.

As the head maid on night duty, Zhixi slept on a simple couch separated from the inner chamber by a heavy curtain, always attentive to her mistress's movements.

Feeling agitated, Xie Yihua simply sat up and said toward the curtain: "Zhixi, come in."

"Yes, Miss." Zhixi responded, quickly lighting a small glass lamp and lifting the curtain to enter.

The warm, dim light instantly dispelled the darkness of the room, and Zhixi saw the gloom and unease on Xie Yihua’s face.

Zhixi hurriedly placed the lamp on the bedside table and leaned in with concern: "Miss, what is wrong? Are you feeling unwell?"

Zhixi and Hongshao had grown up with Xie Yihua. At this moment, Zhixi keenly sensed that something was wrong with her mistress's mood.

Xie Yihua looked at Zhixi.

Zhixi and Hongshao were the people she trusted most; there were some things she could only say to them.

Xie Yihua was silent for a moment, then said gloomily: "...Zhixi, don't you think Cousin Sese is truly beautiful?"

Zhixi was stunned at first, then immediately understood the root of Xie Yihua’s restlessness.

Her heart skipped a beat, and she quickly smiled: "Miss means Cousin Jiang? She is indeed good-looking, but so what? It’s just a shell. With her background, parents deceased, and living under someone else’s roof, no matter how beautiful she is, she cannot carry herself with stature."

"In this servant's eyes, the best she can hope for is to be a scholar’s wife. How can she compare to you, Miss? You are the true golden branch and jade leaf; your grace and air are not something a mere pretty face can match."

Zhixi tried to belittle Jiang Sese to soothe Xie Yihua.

Xie Yihua, of course, understood this.

The chasm of status was a gap Jiang Sese could never cross.

Xie Yihua lowered her eyes, twisting her silk handkerchief in frustration, and said slowly: "Yes, she cannot be a wife, but precisely because of that, she has nothing to lose. Being a concubine... what would stop her?"

Zhixi’s heart tightened; she instantly understood what her mistress was truly worried about.

Her mistress was afraid that Jiang Sese, who was so intent on climbing the social ladder, would shamelessly cling to the young Marquis Chu, even if it meant being a concubine.

Thinking of Jiang Sese’s previous history of falling into the water to get close to the young Marquis, Zhixi’s eyes turned cold.

This Jiang Sese was indeed a restless threat!

Zhixi thought for a moment and whispered: "I understand your concern, Miss. Since she is so shameless, why don't we... give her a push?"

"Give her a push?" Xie Yihua’s eyes flashed as she looked at Zhixi. "What kind of push?"

chapters.title: Setting Her Sights on the Eldest Young Master?
chapters.content:
Zhixi lowered her voice even further: "You know the Second Madam; she values rules and propriety above all else and cannot tolerate even a grain of sand in her eyes. If she were to find out that Cousin Jiang dared to be shameless enough to secretly have someone deliver gifts to the young Marquis Chu... what do you think the Second Madam would do?"

Zhixi didn't finish her sentence, but the implication was clear.

A cousin living in the manor daring to covet a noble Marquis and engaging in such scandalous behavior, if this reached the ears of the Second Madam, Wang, the consequences were easy to imagine.

Madam Wang would never tolerate someone who tarnished the family name and potentially implicated her own daughter to remain in the manor!

She might even take Jiang Sese’s life directly.

Xie Yihua listened quietly, her face expressionless.

Letting her Second Aunt handle Jiang Sese was indeed the best way.

Xie Yihua did not agree immediately, remaining silent for a while, struggling internally.

After a long time, Xie Yihua let out a soft breath, as if shedding a heavy burden, and lay back down, her voice returning to its usual calm: "...It’s late, sleep."

"Yes, Miss." Zhixi understood, bowed respectfully, blew out the glass lamp, and retreated from the inner chamber.

The curtain fell, separating the inside from the outside once more.

...

How to approach Xie Jue was a big problem, especially since she had a history of trying to climb the social ladder, and Xie Jue wasn't someone you could just approach.

Jiang Sese still remembered how the original owner died in the book.

However, while approaching Xie Jue was difficult, approaching his maids was not.

The book mentioned that Xie Jue liked sweets.

Jiang Sese decided to make an ancient-style mango coconut milk jelly.

When she lived alone in the modern era, she cooked for herself to save money, and almost all the desserts and bread she ate were homemade.

Although there were no gelatin sheets in this era, she knew a substitute: agar-agar made from seaweed.

Since ancient times, there had been a tradition of boiling seaweed into a gelatinous substance.

While not common in aristocratic circles, the materials were definitely obtainable.

Thinking it, she did it.

In the afternoon, while the kitchen was less busy, Jiang Sese took only her maid, Lü'e, and went over.

The Xie family’s kitchen had been specially expanded when the old master was alive. It occupied a corner in the northwest of the manor, complete with a greenhouse, an ice cellar, and a dry goods warehouse, consisting of over a dozen rooms, more organized than the residences of ordinary middle-class families.

The kitchen was divided into outer and inner kitchens, a pastry department, and a tea-snack room.

Each had its own duties, and no rules could be broken.

Take the pastry department, for example.

There were five cooks specializing in pastries, who had to be on duty by 5 AM to prepare the ingredients for the day.

From late morning to mid-afternoon, the pastry department was filled with aromas, sweet, salty, flaky, soft, all categorized on gold-painted lacquer trays, delivered to the rooms of the masters by designated servants. There were over twenty types of pastries to choose from daily.

Jiang Sese didn't go to the pastry department; she went to the tea-snack room.

The tea-snack room had two courtyards: the front for production, the back for storage and drying.

There were twelve people serving there alone.

In addition to the three head matrons, there were four assistant maids, two servants responsible for purchasing fresh ingredients, and two maids in charge of charcoal and utensils.

There was also an old matron specializing in tasting and seasoning, whom Princess Anning had specially invited from Jiangnan. It was said that in her youth, she had worked in the tea-snack room of the Textile Bureau and had a very discerning palate.

Jiang Sese quickly slipped a small piece of silver into Matron Liu’s hand and smiled: "Matron Liu, I displeased the Second Madam yesterday, but fortunately, Qingshuang, the maid by the Eldest Cousin’s side, spoke up for me. So, I would like to borrow your space to make some snacks to thank her. I hope you can make it convenient for me and help me find some things."

Although Jiang Sese was a distant cousin, the Xie family treated her like one of their own daughters, providing her with two maids and a monthly allowance of two taels of silver.

However, the original owner had only been in the manor for a month.

Jiang Sese didn't have much money, but she needed Matron Liu’s help, so she had to pay.

After all, she wasn't a real master of the Xie manor.

Matron Liu weighed the heavy silver in her hand and looked at the stunningly beautiful cousin before her, feeling slightly surprised.

The Eldest Young Master?

Qingshuang?

Qingshuang actually spoke up for this cousin?

If Jiang Sese hadn't mentioned Qingshuang, it would be one thing, but anything involving the Eldest Young Master was something a small cook like her couldn't afford to offend.

Not to mention, Jiang Sese had started with a whole tael of silver; that was truly generous.

The maids only got two taels a month.

Matron Liu rolled her eyes and immediately greeted her with a smile: "I don't know what you need, Miss?"

Jiang Sese said: "Please, Matron, give me some fresh coconut meat, high-quality milk, white sugar, and seaweed, as much as possible."

Seaweed? Matron Liu was stunned. They had it, usually for making jelly, but for snacks? She had never heard of it.

But for the sake of the silver, Matron Liu didn't ask and quickly prepared everything for Jiang Sese.

Jiang Sese rolled up her sleeves, washed the seaweed repeatedly, added enough water, and simmered it over low heat.

The kitchen was filled with steam.

An hour later, the seaweed had dissolved into a thick, transparent gelatin. Jiang Sese carefully filtered out the residue with fine gauze, obtaining a bowl of crystal-clear agar liquid.

Then, she mixed the coconut milk and dairy, added an appropriate amount of sugar, and heated it over low heat in a small pot.

The air was filled with the rich, sweet aroma of coconut milk.

Jiang Sese slowly poured the warm coconut milk into the agar liquid, stirring quickly. The delicate milk and the transparent gelatin blended perfectly, presenting an alluring milky white.

Afterward, she took several small, exquisite white porcelain bowls and placed a layer of evenly diced fresh mango at the bottom.

She carefully poured the mixed coconut milk agar into the bowls, covering the mango.

Once done, Jiang Sese carefully placed the bowls in a cool, ventilated corner to set.

Jiang Sese breathed a sigh of relief and turned to instruct Matron Liu righteously: "Matron Liu, please keep an eye on this and don't let anyone touch it. I will come to get it later."

Matron Liu accepted the silver and naturally nodded, but she muttered to herself, What is this cousin up to? Can that stuff really be eaten?

Several hours later, dusk fell.

Jiang Sese returned to the kitchen.

She held her breath and gently lifted the clean gauze covering the bowls.

It worked!

The liquid in the bowls had completely solidified, presenting a semi-transparent texture. A gentle shake showed the bouncy jelly trembling slightly.

The golden mango cubes were embedded within, like amber set in jade. The fragrance of coconut milk mixed with the sweet scent of mango drifted out, extremely tempting.

Jiang Sese used a small silver spoon to scoop a tiny piece and put it in her mouth.

Cold!

Smooth!

The coconut fragrance instantly filled her tongue, with just the right amount of sweetness. The bouncy jelly melted in her mouth, followed by the rich, sweet fruit flavor of the mango... the texture was layered, refreshing, and not cloying, a perfect recreation of the taste in her memory!

Because she used pure, natural ingredients, the flavor was even purer.

This was it!

A glimmer of light flashed in Jiang Sese’s eyes.

She selected the four best-looking bowls, packed them in a food box, and headed to Tingsong Courtyard.

...

Outside Tingsong Courtyard, Qin'an was guarding listlessly when he saw someone walking gracefully toward the end of the path, carrying an exquisite food box.

The figure was slender, the gait light, and the dim light blurred her features, adding to her ethereal beauty.

As the figure approached, the lamp light illuminated her stunning face.

Qin'an recognized her immediately; it was the cousin living in the manor.

The look of amazement on Qin'an’s face froze instantly, then his brow twitched violently, and his heart sank.

Bad luck, how did she find her way to Tingsong Courtyard?

Don't tell me that after failing to cling to the young Marquis Chu, she’s now set her sights on our Eldest Young Master?

chapters.title: It seems different from what others said
chapters.content:
The eldest young master detests such frivolous behavior.

Qin An complained inwardly, feeling that he was truly unlucky today to have been saddled with such a hot potato.

He couldn't help but feel a bit cynical; this young lady was truly shameless, daring to approach the eldest young master!

She didn't even bother to see if she was worthy.

Seeing Jiang Sese already close by, Qin An straightened his back, stepped forward, and blocked the courtyard gate. His tone was stiff, carrying obvious detachment and wariness: "Cousin, please stop. May I ask what business brings you to Tingsong Courtyard? The eldest young master is not receiving guests at the moment."

Qin An was already prepared for her to pester him, his eyes full of vigilance.

It was as if Jiang Sese were some kind of ferocious beast.

But to Qin An's surprise, Jiang Sese stopped voluntarily while still a few steps away from the gate.

Jiang Sese offered a smile and said, "You’ve misunderstood, young man. Sese is not here to seek the eldest cousin, nor would I dare to disturb his peace."

Qin An was stunned, looking at Jiang Sese suspiciously: "Then, Miss, you are...?"

Jiang Sese lifted the food box in her hand slightly and said, "Yesterday, I was nearly punished. It was thanks to Qingshuang’s intervention that I was spared. I felt grateful, and thinking that Qingshuang works hard serving the eldest cousin every day, I personally prepared some snacks and treats as a small token of my appreciation."

Jiang Sese added, "I know the rules of Tingsong Courtyard are strict, so I dare not enter without permission. I would trouble you to pass this food box to Qingshuang, and just tell her it is a small gesture from me, and I hope she will accept it and have a taste."

These words were logical and clear, and her tone was incredibly sincere, which was completely unexpected to Qin An.

She wasn't here to see the eldest young master?

She was here to thank Sister Qingshuang?

So that was it!

A look of surprise and annoyance immediately appeared on Qin An's face.

This cousin... although her reputation was a bit poor, she seemed to be the type who knows how to repay kindness?

Qin An looked at Jiang Sese. There was no pretense on that beautiful face; there was only gratitude and a hint of cautious anticipation in her eyes.

Qin An suddenly felt his face burning, as if he had been silently slapped.

He quickly suppressed all his disrespect, his voice softening involuntarily as he smiled: "You are very thoughtful, Miss."

As he spoke, Qin An stepped forward and respectfully took the food box with both hands: "Don't worry, Miss, I will personally deliver this to Sister Qingshuang."

"I have troubled you, young man." A faint smile appeared on Jiang Sese's face, looking exceptionally moving in the twilight.

"Not at all, not at all, you are too kind, Miss," Qin An quickly replied.

After Jiang Sese left, Qin An looked down at the food box in his hands, and thinking of his own rudeness just now, he felt even more apologetic.

When someone came to relieve him, Qin An carried the food box and walked briskly through the courtyard gate to find Qingshuang.

This cousin seemed... a bit different from what others said?

...

Carrying the food box, Qin An walked briskly to the outside of Qingshuang’s room, only to find she wasn't there.

After thinking for a moment, he turned toward the front courtyard.

Under the corridor of the front courtyard, the maid Chao Lu saw Qin An carrying an exquisite food box and immediately came over, asking curiously: "Why did you come this way? What are you carrying? Let me see!"

Qin An quickly dodged, saying: "It’s that cousin, Jiang Sese. She personally made some snacks to thank Sister Qingshuang for speaking up for her in front of the Second Madam yesterday, and asked me to pass them on."

Qin An couldn't help but add, "That cousin was so polite and knows the rules; she really doesn't look as unbearable as the rumors say... Hurry and help me see if Sister Qingshuang is busy. If not, please ask her to come out."

When Chao Lu heard it was for Qingshuang and that it was personally made by the cousin, she couldn't help but smile: "Alright, Sister Qingshuang is inside serving the eldest young master his meal. You wait, I'll go check for you."

As she spoke, Chao Lu walked softly to the door of the main room.

Inside the inner chamber, the candles were bright, and Qingshuang was standing by the table. Another head maid, Shutong, was serving the dishes.

Chao Lu didn't dare to look too much and whispered to Qingshuang: "Sister Qingshuang, Qin An is outside, saying someone sent something for you."

Qingshuang frowned slightly, feeling surprised.

Who would send her something at this time?

Qingshuang subconsciously glanced at the person in the main seat.

Seeing that he showed no reaction, Qingshuang knew it was tacitly approved and whispered to Chao Lu: "I'll go out now."

Qingshuang then curtsied slightly to the person in the main seat and exited the inner chamber silently.

Arriving at the corridor of the front courtyard, Qin An immediately greeted her, handed over the food box, and repeated Jiang Sese's words at a fast pace: "...The cousin said it was to thank you for speaking up for her yesterday in front of the Second Madam, and she personally made some snacks as a token of thanks. She specifically said she didn't dare to disturb the eldest young master's peace and that it was just for you, Sister."

As Qin An spoke, remembering Jiang Sese's sincere and grateful expression, he couldn't help but add: "Sister Qingshuang, you didn't see it, but the cousin's attitude was truly sincere. I think she is quite grateful."

Chao Lu, who was nearby, also leaned in, curiously examining the food box: "Personally made by the cousin? What kind of snacks are they? Open it and let's see!"

Qingshuang felt a slight stir in her heart. Although Qin An was young, he wasn't unobservant. Since he said so, it seemed Jiang Sese's performance today was indeed different.

After a moment of contemplation, under the expectant gazes of Chao Lu and Qin An, Qingshuang gently opened the lid of the food box.

What came into view were four small, pristine white porcelain bowls.

Inside the bowls were jellies as translucent as fine amber, trembling slightly under the light of the lanterns in the corridor, emitting an alluring luster.

Embedded within the jelly were many plump pieces of fruit that looked like crushed gold; they were diced mangoes.

A refreshing, sweet, and rich coconut fragrance mixed with the unique sweetness of mango wafted out, carrying a hint of coolness. It was completely different from the greasy, sugary scent typical of the kitchen, appearing exceptionally fresh and tempting.

"What is this?" Chao Lu couldn't help but gasp, her eyes wide. "It looks like solidified honey water? But it doesn't... and this fruit, it's mango from the south, right? Not to mention how it tastes, just looking at it, it's truly beautiful!"

Qingshuang had also never seen a snack in such a form.

The jelly was trembling, appearing as if it would break at a touch, its color clear and pure, dotted with golden fruit; it was visually stunning.

Just as the three of them were surrounding the small food box, marveling at the four bowls of crystal-clear "coconut milk jelly," the curtain of the inner chamber was lifted by a fair hand.

Shutong, the other head maid beside Xie Jue, walked out and called: "Qingshuang."

Hearing this, Qingshuang quickly closed the lid of the food box, turned around, and replied: "What is it?"

chapters.title: What are you holding in your hand?
chapters.content:
Shutong's gaze lingered on the food box for a moment before saying, "The eldest young master is calling for you to come in."

Qingshuang's heart tightened. Not daring to delay, she immediately replied, "I'm coming right away."

Inside the inner chamber, the meal had already been cleared away.

The man was not in the study handling official business as usual, but was still sitting upright in the sandalwood chair at the head of the table.

He had changed into a casual black brocade robe, which made his skin appear even colder and paler. His slender fingers were casually flipping through a book spread out on the small sandalwood table. His posture was relaxed, yet an oppressive air of authority emanated from him.

Hearing the footsteps, he did not look up.

Qingshuang and Shutong stood respectfully to the side, heads bowed.

Qingshuang was carrying the food box.

A faint, sweet fragrance quietly permeated the room.

Xie Jue’s gaze finally lifted from the book and landed on the food box.

His look was very light, just a casual glance, yet it carried an invisible pressure.

Xie Jue: "What are you holding in your hand?"

Qingshuang's heart skipped a beat, and she quickly lowered her head and replied respectfully: "Reporting to Young Master, it is a snack sent by Cousin Jiang. She said she made it herself and sent it specifically to thank this servant for speaking up for her in front of the Second Madam yesterday."

Hearing this, Xie Jue’s face remained expressionless. His gaze lingered on the food box for a moment before he said faintly, "Bring it here."

Qingshuang and Shutong were both slightly startled.

The Young Master... wants to see the snack?

This was truly beyond their expectations.

Not daring to hesitate, Qingshuang stepped forward a few paces and placed the food box gently on the table in front of Xie Jue.

Shutong stepped forward as well, helping to open the lid.

Inside the box were four bowls of crystal-clear mango coconut milk jelly.

Under the bright and soft candlelight of the room, the semi-transparent amber jelly looked even more lustrous and clear, trembling in the elegant white porcelain bowls. The golden mango cubes looked like fragments of solidified sunlight, and the sweet coconut fragrance mixed with the rich mango scent drifted out in wisps, carrying a refreshing coolness.

A flash of amazement quickly crossed Shutong's eyes.

Qingshuang glanced at Xie Jue’s expression.

The Young Master remained as calm as ever, his eyes deep, revealing neither like nor dislike.

Not daring to delay, Qingshuang quickly took out a bowl of the milk jelly from the food box.

The bottom of the box contained small silver spoons, but Qingshuang knew the Young Master had a cleanliness obsession, so she fetched one of Xie Jue’s usual white porcelain spoons.

Qingshuang gently placed the white porcelain bowl and the spoon by Xie Jue’s hand.

Xie Jue did not reach for it immediately. His gaze lingered on the trembling jelly for a moment before he slowly extended his slender fingers to take the bowl and spoon.

His movements were unhurried, carrying an innate nobility.

Qingshuang lowered her head slightly.

Xie Jue scooped up a small piece of the jelly. The jelly was broken by the spoon and then slightly bounced back, appearing exceptionally supple.

Xie Jue took a small bite, along with a few pieces of golden mango, and put it into his mouth.

It was cool, smooth, and tender, instantly dispelling the slight greasiness left from dinner. The mellow fragrance of coconut milk spread across his tongue, sweet but not cloying.

Then, just as Qingshuang and Shutong thought they were seeing things, they saw the Young Master scoop up a second spoonful.

A third.

A fourth...

Qingshuang and Shutong: ??!

Xie Jue still ate very slowly, his posture elegant and composed, but the movement of the spoon did not stop.

The bowl of jelly, which had been full, began to shrink at a speed visible to the naked eye...

Qingshuang and Shutong were incredibly surprised; after all, the Young Master had only finished his dinner a short while ago.

He had always been disciplined in his diet, and the various desserts meticulously prepared by the mansion rarely caught his eye, let alone made him take a second spoonful.

But this seemingly ordinary snack in front of them...

Not only did the Young Master eat it, but...

He had eaten half the bowl?!

Xie Jue finally put down the bowl and spoon.

In the bowl, half of the semi-transparent jelly and golden fruit had disappeared, leaving only a smooth arc.

The two maids were secretly astonished.

Xie Jue suddenly looked up and asked, "Did the cousin make this?"

His tone was flat and waveless, as if he were just asking casually.

Qingshuang was stunned for a moment, then quickly replied: "Yes, that is what Qin An said."

Hearing this, Xie Jue said nothing more.

There were still three full bowls of jelly left on the table.

Xie Jue waved his hand casually.

Qingshuang understood immediately, stepped forward to carefully remove the bowl and spoon the Young Master had used, quickly closed the lid, and picked up the entire food box.

Not daring to look at Xie Jue’s expression, she exchanged a look of shock and confusion with Shutong, and then silently bowed and exited the inner chamber.

...

When Jiang Sese returned to the courtyard with Lü'e, the night had deepened.

Just as she stepped into the courtyard, she saw Chun Tao hurrying in from outside, her face still showing a trace of lingering panic, her steps hurried.

Seeing Jiang Sese, Chun Tao was clearly startled. She quickly stopped and bowed: "Cousin is back."

Jiang Sese’s gaze swept over Chun Tao lightly.

Chun Tao and Lü'e were both the original owner's personal maids, but their intentions were completely different.

Although Lü'e had her own thoughts, she was smart and steady.

And this Chun Tao...

Jiang Sese knew clearly that the original owner was obsessed with climbing the social ladder, while Chun Tao was focused on finding a promising master; the two could be considered like-minded.

Jiang Sese asked: "Where did you go?"

Chun Tao calmed down quickly and replied: "Reporting to you, Miss, this servant went to the needlework room to get the silk thread you ordered a few days ago. The manager was delayed for a while, so I returned late."

As she spoke, Chun Tao took a small thread pouch from her sleeve.

Jiang Sese glanced at the pouch, didn't pursue the matter, and walked straight into the room.

Chun Tao breathed a sigh of relief behind her and exchanged a look with Lü'e. Lü'e just shook her head silently and followed Jiang Sese inside.

At night, it was Chun Tao’s turn to be on duty.

Chun Tao helped Jiang Sese remove her jewelry and outer garments.

The candlelight in the room flickered, and the atmosphere felt a bit quiet.

As Chun Tao organized the clothes Jiang Sese had changed out of, her eyes darted around. Suddenly, she spoke as if unintentionally, her voice filled with exaggerated envy: "Cousin, you say this Young Master Chu... his family background is prominent, and his appearance is impeccable. How many noble ladies in the capital are looking at him with longing? Whoever is lucky enough to enter the Chu Duke's mansion, even as a concubine, would truly be a blessing cultivated over eight hundred lifetimes."

As Chun Tao spoke, she secretly observed Jiang Sese’s reaction.

Jiang Sese was combing her long hair in front of the mirror. Hearing this, her movements didn't stop, and there was no expression on her face, as if she hadn't heard.
