Seeing that Jiang Sese didn't respond, Chun Tao continued to smile: "This servant heard the young servants in the front courtyard chatting today, saying that Young Master Chu is not only handsome but also talented, and he is very kind to others. Such a husband is hard to find even with a lantern!"

"Cousin, don't you think so?"

Jiang Sese stopped combing her hair, turned her face slightly, and looked at Chun Tao behind her with a half-smile: "Chun Tao, what exactly are you trying to say?"

chapters.title: Why Not Try a Little Harder
chapters.content:
Chuntao felt a chill at this gaze, but remembering her own plans, she forced herself to remain calm. She piled on a smile and said, "This servant is just worried for you, Miss. Everyone in the manor knows of your sincere heart toward Young Master Chu. Although there were some misunderstandings before, a great man like Young Master Chu surely wouldn't take them to heart. Why doesn't Miss try a little harder?"

Jiang Sese turned around to face Chuntao directly, the candlelight reflecting off her exquisitely beautiful smiling face. "Oh? How should I try harder?"

Chuntao felt a surge of joy and hurriedly lowered her voice. "This servant was thinking, Miss could hand-embroider a sachet and entrust someone to deliver it to Young Master Chu as a token of your feelings. A young lady's heart hidden within needlework is the most subtle and moving gesture. Once Young Master Chu sees it, he will surely understand your intentions."

Jiang Sese watched quietly as Chuntao spoke with such animation. She curled her lips slightly and said, "Embroider a sachet? That is indeed a good idea."

Hearing this, the smile on Chuntao's face grew even wider. "Miss thinks so too? Then this servant will go prepare the best fabric and silk threads tomorrow. Miss is so clever with her hands; the sachet you embroider will surely make Young Master Chu happy."

Jiang Sese stopped looking at her and turned toward the bed. "Extinguish the lamp."

"Yes." Chuntao responded quickly and blew out the candle on the table, leaving only a dim light in the corner.

The room immediately fell into a hazy darkness.

As Chuntao lay on the small daybed in the outer room, she was still calculating the matter of the sachet. The more she thought about it, the more smoothly the plan seemed to be going, and she couldn't help but let her lips curl upward.

In the darkness, she did not see that on the bed in the inner room, Jiang Sese had slowly opened her eyes, a flash of cold mockery crossing them.

Because the original owner was a cannon fodder character in the book, the story never mentioned who had instigated her. It only briefly stated that she had been gobbled up by suggestions, sent a sachet, and was beaten to death on the orders of Madam Wang, with even Concubine Sun’s tearful pleas proving useless.

Since Jiang Sese had transmigrated here, she had been keeping this matter in mind.

Now, she finally knew.

She knew exactly how it had all come to pass.

Jiang Sese gently closed her eyes, her lips curving into a faint arc.

...

The next day, Tingsong Courtyard.

After Xie Jue finished his breakfast, he picked up the clear tea beside him and suddenly said, "That snack from yesterday was quite refreshing."

Qingshuang, who was standing by, felt her heart jump.

The Young Master... was he talking about the snack Miss Jiang made yesterday?

Not only did he break his rule and eat half a bowl yesterday, but he even specifically mentioned it today?

Qingshuang kept her expression calm and replied respectfully, "The Young Master is right."

However, her mind was racing.

What the Young Master meant... was that he wanted to taste it again?

As her thoughts turned, Qingshuang had an idea.

After Xie Jue left for the study, Qingshuang found an excuse to go to the front courtyard, where she happened to see the young maid Zhaolu wiping the pillars.

"Zhaolu," Qingshuang called out.

Zhaolu quickly put down her rag. "Sister Qingshuang, do you have any instructions?"

Qingshuang said, "There is something I would like to trouble you with. Do you remember the snack that Miss Jiang sent over yesterday?"

"I remember, I remember. Miss is truly clever with her hands," Zhaolu nodded immediately, her eyes brightening.

Yesterday, the Young Master had eaten one bowl, and there were three bowls left, which Qingshuang had shared with Shutong and Zhaolu.

Qingshuang continued, "I found it quite refreshing and delicious, especially the coconut fragrance; it was very unique, and I find myself still thinking about it. Since Miss said she made it herself yesterday, could you run to the West Courtyard for me and ask if it would be convenient for her to make another portion? Just say that I am greedy and want to be thick-skinned enough to ask for it again."

As she spoke, Qingshuang reached into her sleeve, took out a small piece of silver worth two taels, and pressed it into Zhaolu's hand. "Give this to Miss; consider it money for the ingredients. I cannot take things from her for nothing. If it is difficult for her, don't say anything more, just come back and tell me."

Clutching the silver and hearing that it was Sister Qingshuang who wanted to eat it, Zhaolu immediately said, "Sister, don't worry. Leave this to me; I'll go right now."

Zhaolu quickly left Tingsong Courtyard and headed toward the West Courtyard.

The further she walked, the more remote and desolate it became. After bypassing several flower beds and corridors that were clearly neglected, she finally found the small courtyard where Jiang Sese lived in a very secluded corner.

The courtyard gate was narrow, and there were only two small side rooms inside; the space was extremely cramped.

Standing at the gate, Zhaolu couldn't help but mutter to herself that this place was too remote. It was even worse than the living quarters of some of the manor's head servants.

But then again, for a poor, distant relation of a cousin, it was good enough to have a place to stay.

Zhaolu thought for a moment and knocked on the courtyard gate.

Chuntao opened the door. Seeing a maid she didn't recognize standing outside, she was stunned and asked, "Who are you looking for?"

Zhaolu lifted her chin slightly and said, "I am a maid from Tingsong Courtyard. My name is Zhaolu. I am here to see Miss Jiang on the orders of Sister Qingshuang."

"From Tingsong Courtyard?!" Chuntao and Lü'e, who had come out at the sound, exclaimed simultaneously.

In their eyes, the Young Master was a god on high, and the maids in his courtyard, even those who swept the floors, were superior to others.

Chuntao and Lü'e’s attitudes immediately became incredibly attentive and warm.

"So it's a sister from Tingsong Courtyard! Please, come in, come in!" Chuntao hurriedly stepped aside to make way.

Lü'e also quickly bowed. "Greetings, Sister Zhaolu."

Watching their instant change in attitude, the slight disdain Zhaolu had felt due to the shabby courtyard was replaced by a sense of superiority. Her lips curled up slightly. "No need for trouble. I am here to see Miss on Sister Qingshuang's orders."

Chuntao quickly said, "Sister, please wait a moment. I will go report to Miss."

With that, she turned and ran into the house.

Soon, Chuntao ran back out. "Miss invites you in."

Lü'e quickly led the way.

Inside the room, Jiang Sese, who was embroidering a sachet, looked up at the sound.

At just one glance, Zhaolu felt as if she had been frozen in place; she even forgot to breathe.

Zhaolu had always stayed in Tingsong Courtyard and rarely went to other courtyards. She had heard many rumors about this Miss Jiang living in the manor, both good and bad, and naturally, there was no shortage of talk about her appearance.

They all said she was extremely beautiful, even a bit bewitching.

But hearing was one thing; Zhaolu had always thought it was an exaggeration.

chapters.title: Seeing is Believing
chapters.content:
Seeing is believing.

The Miss Jiang before her was wearing only a slightly worn light-green dress, with no makeup, her dark hair loosely pinned up, and a few stray strands hanging by her cheeks.

Yet, even with such simple attire, it could not hide the breathtaking quality of her face.

It was a beauty that bordered on the ethereal.

Her skin was as lustrous as snow, appearing to have its own soft glow in the dim light.

Her brows were naturally dark like distant mountains shrouded in mist, and as her eyes moved, they held infinite charm.

It was like a long-sealed masterpiece suddenly unfolding before one's eyes; all the colors and brilliance erupted in an instant, illuminating the simple inner room.

Zhaolu felt her mind go blank, leaving only this soul-stirring face before her.

No wonder there were so many rumors about her in the manor.

With such beauty...

Even the ladies in the palace could be no more than this!!

Jiang Sese smiled slightly and said, "Sister Zhaolu is here, please sit. I wonder what matter Sister Qingshuang sent you here for?"

Looking at this Miss with the face of a peerless beauty, the sense of superiority Zhaolu had felt somehow faded, and her attitude became subconsciously more respectful.

Zhaolu didn't dare to sit; she just curtsied slightly. "This servant, Zhaolu, greets Miss. It was Sister Qingshuang who sent me."

Zhaolu repeated everything Qingshuang had told her word for word, then added, "Sister Qingshuang said she would never dare to take your things for nothing. Please accept this silver as payment for the materials. If it is inconvenient for you, please do not feel troubled."

Jiang Sese’s gaze lingered on the silver in Zhaolu's hand for a moment before slowly shifting to Zhaolu's face, which held a mix of anticipation and slight nervousness.

Although she was dying to take the money immediately, Jiang Sese restrained herself.

She deliberately showed a look of surprise and quickly said, "It is an honor that Sister Qingshuang likes them. It is just a small snack, nothing worth mentioning. Please take this silver back and tell Sister Qingshuang that there is really no need to be so polite. I will have my maid send it over once I have made it later."

Upon hearing this, Zhaolu insisted, pushing the silver forward again. "Miss, please don't say that. Sister Qingshuang specifically instructed me, saying that since the snacks are handmade by you, they take time and effort, and the ingredients cost money. We absolutely cannot take your things for free. If you refuse to accept it, I won't be able to answer to Sister Qingshuang when I return."

Jiang Sese’s gaze lingered on Zhaolu's insistent hand and the silver for another moment, as if she were seriously considering the other's dilemma.

Jiang Sese sighed softly, a helpless yet grateful smile appearing on her face. "Sister Qingshuang is truly so thoughtful. In that case..."

Jiang Sese finally reached out and accepted the silver. "Then I will be thick-skinned and accept it. Please thank Sister Qingshuang for me when you return."

With the silver in hand, Jiang Sese’s heart felt a bit more settled.

She had no idea if she could win over Xie Jue.

The reason Jiang Sese sent food to Qingshuang was that she was certain the head maid of Tingsong Courtyard would not be short of silver.

Jiang Sese wanted to earn some money from Qingshuang, and secondly, she was gambling on a "what if."

After all, Qingshuang was Xie Jue’s head maid; maids always talked among themselves. As long as Qingshuang mentioned it once or twice and Xie Jue happened to hear it, once his curiosity was piqued and he ate the snack she made...

Jiang Sese was confident that Xie Jue would be satisfied.

But if Xie Jue remained uninterested in what she made, so be it.

Once she had saved enough silver, she would move out of the Xie manor and buy a house of her own.

Jiang Sese’s fingers in her sleeve subconsciously rubbed the silver, her expression remaining gentle. "Please tell Sister Qingshuang that making these snacks is not much trouble. I will go prepare the ingredients now, and once they are ready, I will have my maid send them to Tingsong Courtyard immediately."

Seeing that Jiang Sese had accepted the silver and agreed so readily, Zhaolu beamed. "Yes, I will definitely pass on the message. Thank you, Miss. I will go back to report now."

Zhaolu curtsied happily and turned to leave.

Chuntao and Lü'e hurriedly saw Zhaolu out.

Watching Zhaolu walk away, Lü'e let out a soft sigh and whispered, "Miss, that silver..."

Lü'e hesitated, feeling that Jiang Sese’s behavior was strange.

How could she really accept silver from that side?

Of course, Lü'e could not have guessed that Jiang Sese was actually saving money to leave the Xie family.

Chuntao, however, rolled her eyes and smiled. "Sister Qingshuang is so generous. Miss, about making the snacks, why don't you let me do it?"

Jiang Sese looked at Chuntao and asked with a smile, "You want to learn?"

Chuntao nodded eagerly.

Having more skills never hurts. Once the Miss died, she could take over and continue making snacks for Qingshuang. She could earn money and curry favor with Qingshuang; perhaps she would even have a chance to enter Tingsong Courtyard herself.

Jiang Sese raised her eyebrows. She had no objection to someone else doing the work.

Jiang Sese explained the method to Chuntao in detail, and Chuntao went off happily.

Lü'e, standing to the side, lowered her eyes and said nothing.

Jiang Sese looked at Lü'e and asked, "Do you not want to learn?"

chapters.title: Without Even Lifting an Eyelid
chapters.content:
Lü'e looked up and smiled, "If you want me to learn, Miss, I will learn. If you don't want me to learn, I won't."

Originally, Lü'e’s intentions were the same as Chuntao’s: both were hoping to switch to a more promising master to serve.

But over the past two days, watching Jiang Sese quietly win over Qingshuang from Tingsong Courtyard, Lü'e immediately changed her mind.

If it were the cousin of the past, she was just a beauty with nothing else to offer, utterly useless.

But now, the cousin...

She seemed to have finally figured things out; she didn't look so foolish anymore.

With beauty and a bit of cleverness, she wouldn't do too badly.

Lü'e thought it over and over, finally settling her heart on following Jiang Sese properly.

Chuntao went to the kitchen to make snacks, so Jiang Sese took Lü'e to pay her respects to Madam Wang at Zhaohua Hall.

Madam Wang’s hatred for the original owner stemmed from three things:

First, Jiang Sese’s background.

Second, Jiang Sese’s face.

Every time Madam Wang saw it, she found it an eyesore.

That face carried an unconscious allure, as if she were a siren born to seduce men.

Third, and what Madam Wang despised most, was Jiang Sese’s previous behavior.

As an orphan, she dared to covet the noble Prince Chu.

She even tried to use a lowly tactic like falling into the water to climb the social ladder; it was shameless and had brought disgrace to the entire Xie household.

The old woman at the courtyard gate didn't even lift an eyelid when she saw them, only saying lazily, "The Madam has just risen and is having breakfast. The cousin should wait in the corridor."

Having said that, she stood to one side, glancing sideways with undisguised neglect.

A flash of indignation crossed Lü'e’s eyes, and her lips moved, but she was stopped by a look from Jiang Sese.

Jiang Sese said, "Thank you for the trouble, Mother. I shall wait here."

This wait lasted for a full half-hour.

The early summer morning breeze carried a chill, and after standing for so long, one’s hands and feet began to stiffen.

Lü'e stole a glance at Jiang Sese, only to see her standing straight, eyes lowered, her long lashes casting a small shadow that hid all her emotions.

On that face, which was enough to dim the sun and moon, there was only stillness.

Finally, a well-dressed head maid lifted the curtain and came out. She glanced at the two of them and said in a flat tone, "The Madam invites the cousin in."

Stepping into the main hall, Madam Wang sat upright in the seat of honor, wearing a deep purple brocade jacket with dark patterns. Her hair was combed meticulously, adorned with a gold and kingfisher feather hairpin.

Madam Wang was holding a teacup, gently pushing aside the foam with the lid.

When Jiang Sese entered, Madam Wang didn't even lift an eyelid.

Jiang Sese performed a proper bow to Madam Wang: "Sese pays her respects to the Second Madam."

Only then did Madam Wang slowly lift her eyelids, her gaze landing on that face which remained breathtaking even without makeup.

Madam Wang’s brows furrowed imperceptibly, and her disgust deepened.

Madam Wang set down her teacup. "You fell into the water a few days ago. Although you have recovered, you should run around less and recuperate properly in your own courtyard. Although our Xie household is not a den of tigers or wolves, we still have rules and decorum. Don't learn from those frivolous types who spend their days thinking about climbing high branches and doing unseemly things, dragging down the reputation of my Xie household."

Jiang Sese lowered her eyes and replied calmly, "Yes, Sese will take the Second Madam’s teachings to heart."

It was as if Madam Wang had punched a ball of cotton.

Seeing Jiang Sese’s submissive appearance, Madam Wang felt no satisfaction; instead, the nameless fire in her heart burned even brighter.

That face, paired with this feigned obedience, looked hypocritical and seductive no matter how she viewed it.

Madam Wang’s tone grew more impatient: "As long as you know. I will only say this once. The Xie household tolerates you because of a shred of kindness. If you continue to be ungrateful, harbor any improper thoughts, or cause any trouble... don't blame me for being heartless."

Madam Wang emphasized the last few words heavily.

Jiang Sese glanced at Madam Wang.

It was no wonder that when the incident with the sachet occurred, Madam Wang was so enraged that she ordered the original owner beaten to death.

"Sese understands, Sese would not dare."

Jiang Sese responded respectfully and, with Lü'e, slowly retreated from the main hall of Zhaohua Hall.

Not until they were outside the courtyard gate and had turned a corridor, completely out of sight of Zhaohua Hall, did Jiang Sese’s slightly hunched back slowly straighten.

Lü'e looked at Jiang Sese and asked softly, "Miss, are you alright?"

Jiang Sese nodded slightly, turned to look at Lü'e with clear, penetrating eyes, and smiled: "It was to be expected. Let’s go."

As the two turned a hanging flower gate, they saw someone walking toward them in a hurry.

The man wore a moon-white brocade robe with a jade belt at his waist. He was tall and straight, with a gentle and handsome face, a scholarly air about his brows, and a refined temperament.

Xie Huaizhang was in a hurry to pay his respects to his mother, Madam Wang, but he hadn't expected to run into Jiang Sese here.

A look of pleasant surprise appeared on Xie Huaizhang’s face.

Ever since he learned that Jiang Sese had fallen into the water, Xie Huaizhang had been worried sick.

But due to the separation of men and women, and his mother, Madam Wang, Xie Huaizhang could only inquire through servants, feeling slightly relieved only after learning she was unharmed.

Seeing that Jiang Sese’s complexion was decent, Xie Huaizhang’s heart finally settled.

Xie Huaizhang said warmly, "Cousin, are you well?"

Jiang Sese looked up at the sound, unexpectedly crashing into Xie Huaizhang’s eyes, which were filled with gentleness and joy.

Xie Huaizhang...

Xie Huaizhang was seventeen this year, one year older than Xie Yihua and Xie Yujiao.

And two years older than the original owner.

The book stated that Xie Huaizhang fell in love with the original owner at first sight. Unfortunately, before he could let her know his feelings, she was beaten to death by Madam Wang’s orders due to the sachet incident.

Jiang Sese thought for a moment and bowed to Xie Huaizhang: "Second Young Master, are you well?"

Xie Huaizhang quickly reached out to help her up, "Cousin, there is no need for such formality."

His face was full of undisguised concern: "I heard that you accidentally fell into the water a few days ago, and I have been worried. Is your health fully recovered?"

Lü'e, listening from the side, frowned slightly.

If the Second Young Master showed such concern and it reached the Second Madam’s ears, the cousin would likely suffer again.

Jiang Sese’s internal alarm bells also rang.

She didn't want to give Madam Wang any more excuses.

Jiang Sese immediately stepped back half a pace to create some distance and said with a distant tone: "Thank you for your concern, Second Young Master. Sese has long since recovered."

Xie Huaizhang paused, the light in his eyes dimming for a moment, before he smiled again: "That is good. However, the spring water is cold; you should be more careful and take good care of yourself."

Xie Huaizhang hesitated, wanting to say more, but seeing the distance Jiang Sese was deliberately maintaining, he swallowed his words.

Reluctant to let her go, he searched for a topic: "Cousin, have you just come from paying your respects to Mother?"

chapters.title: How Dare You!
chapters.content:
"Yes." Jiang Sese only wanted to leave as soon as possible. "Second Young Master, you must be going to pay your respects to the Second Madam. Sese dares not delay you, so I will take my leave."

Watching Jiang Sese’s eagerness to leave, Xie Huaizhang couldn't help but feel a wave of disappointment.

But Xie Huaizhang was never one to force others.

He stepped aside slightly, making way: "...Take care on your way, Cousin."

"Thank you, Second Young Master." Jiang Sese didn't look at him again and, with Lü'e, walked quickly past him.

Xie Huaizhang stood where he was, watching her figure disappear at the end of the corridor, remaining motionless for a long time.

He knew full well his mother’s hatred for Cousin Sese.

Because of this, he dared not express his admiration easily, fearing that if his mother found out, she would treat her even worse.

At the other end of the corridor, Jiang Sese didn't let out a sigh of relief until she had turned the corner and was sure Xie Huaizhang couldn't see her.

"Cousin..." Lü'e looked at her cautiously.

Jiang Sese acted as if nothing had happened: "Let’s go back."

The original owner had actually thought about seducing Xie Huaizhang, but the moment she thought of his mother, Madam Wang, she would be terrified.

The original owner had no other choices, which was why she had set her sights on Chu Shaoyuan.

In the book, the original owner had a thought: "If I were born ordinary, that would be one thing, but heaven gave me such beauty, so of course I must fight for it."

If she didn't fight, the best she could hope for, with the help of Concubine Sun, was to marry a scholar.

A scholar was actually not bad compared to a commoner; they had status, didn't have to kneel before officials, and were exempt from land taxes. It wouldn't mean living in luxury, but she would certainly be fed and clothed.

But the original owner was not content with her husband being merely a scholar.

As Jiang Sese walked back with Lü'e, she heard two young maids talking as they approached.

"...Did you hear? There’s news from the Third Young Master!"

"The Third Young Master? Really? He’s been away for quite a while."

"Of course it’s true. I was on duty at the second gate yesterday and heard the servants from the outer courtyard say that the Third Young Master wrote to the First Madam and is already on his way back."

"Oh my, that’s wonderful! The Third Young Master has been gone for over half a year, and the household has been so dull..."

"Indeed, I heard he had a great time playing in Jiangnan this time..."

The two maids hurried past the corner, not noticing Jiang Sese and Lü'e standing in the shadow of a pillar.

Jiang Sese’s heart stirred slightly.

The Third Young Master... Xie Yao?

Xie Yao belonged to the first branch of the family. The book didn't write much about him, only that he was romantic, unrestrained, and lively.

When the original owner arrived at the Xie household, Xie Yao happened to be away visiting friends. By the time this Third Young Master returned to the manor at his leisure, the original owner had already met her end, wrapped in a straw mat and thrown into a mass grave.

Xie Yao was coming back. It seemed the incident with the sachet was also approaching.

Sure enough.

As soon as they returned, Chuntao followed them in, her eyes darting eagerly toward Jiang Sese’s sewing basket.

Chuntao: "Cousin, you’re back! How is the sachet coming along? You must hurry. I heard that people from Prince Chu’s mansion will be coming to our manor in two days to deliver festival gifts for the Dragon Boat Festival. This is a rare opportunity."

Jiang Sese took off her outer garment in a leisurely manner, pursed her lips, and looked at Chuntao with a half-smile: "You dead girl, you’re more anxious than I am. Don't worry, it’s almost done, just a few stitches left."

Hearing that it was almost done, Chuntao’s face lit up with joy: "I’m just anxious for you, Miss."

As night deepened, the small courtyard became completely quiet.

Estimating it was time for bed, Jiang Sese sat under the lamp, holding the carefully embroidered sachet, her eyes deep and inscrutable.

Jiang Sese thought for a moment and called out: "Lü'e, you go."

Lü'e looked up at Jiang Sese and replied: "Yes, Miss."

The moment the sound of Lü'e’s footsteps disappeared outside the door, Jiang Sese whispered: "Chuntao, come in."

Chuntao lifted the curtain almost immediately, her face filled with irrepressible excitement: "Miss, you called me? Is the sachet finished?"

"Yes."

Jiang Sese handed over the sachet, deliberately lowering her voice, and said solemnly: "It is finished. You must be very careful and deliver it personally to the servant by Prince Chu’s side. Don't let anyone else see it! Otherwise, my life will be in danger."

Chuntao snatched the sachet, her heart pounding like a drum, as if she were holding not a sachet, but the ladder to wealth and glory.

As long as she did as she was told.

Once the cousin was dead, she would be transferred to Qiluo Residence.

Chuntao’s face was filled with undisguised joy as she said earnestly: "Don't worry, Miss, I understand! I will definitely find an opportunity to give it to Prince Chu’s man. I will never fail your trust!"

Without waiting for further instructions from Jiang Sese, Chuntao tucked the sachet away and, like a mouse that had stolen oil, slipped out of the room with light footsteps.

Jiang Sese watched the direction she disappeared in and smiled slightly. Little girl, I’ve read the script; do you really think you can trick me?

Jiang Sese sat in the room and waited.

In less time than it takes to drink a cup of tea, heavy and hurried footsteps sounded outside the small courtyard.

Several burly, rough-looking women, accompanied by maids, stormed in aggressively.

The leader, Mother Wang, was the very woman who had neglected Jiang Sese earlier that day.

Mother Wang: "Cousin, the Madam requests your presence. Please come with us to Zhaohua Hall immediately."

Jiang Sese deliberately shrank back, the color instantly draining from her face. She looked at the intruders with panic in her eyes, her voice trembling with confusion: "What is this about? It’s so late... Why does the Second Madam want to see me?"

Mother Wang let out a cold snort through her nose, the disdain in her eyes almost overflowing.

She looked at Jiang Sese’s face, which remained breathtakingly beautiful even in the dim light, as if looking at something filthy: "You’ll know when you get there, Cousin. Please!"

When they arrived at the brightly lit Zhaohua Hall, Madam Wang sat in the seat of honor, her face livid, her chest heaving violently; she was clearly enraged to the extreme.

Chuntao was kneeling not far from Madam Wang’s feet, her head lowered.

Seeing Jiang Sese being brought in by the women, the fire in Madam Wang’s eyes intensified. "Jiang Sese, how dare you!"

chapters.title: Second Madam, please calm your anger; I have been framed!
chapters.content:
Jiang Sese looked straight at Madam Wang and said, "Sese pays her respects to the Second Madam. I do not know why you have summoned me here in the middle of the night?"

Madam Wang laughed out of pure rage: "Why? Jiang Sese! You have the nerve to ask me. I warned you just this morning to keep to yourself and not stir up any more trouble, yet you treated my words as if they were wind! It has only been a few hours, and you have already committed such a shameless and base act!"

The more Madam Wang spoke, the angrier she became. Her chest heaved violently as she grabbed the sachet and threw it at Jiang Sese’s feet: "Look at this yourself! What is this?! You are an unmarried girl, yet you embroider such things and even intend to sneakily pass them to a man outside?! Do you have any sense of shame left? The Xie family took you in out of kindness, not for you to seduce the Young Marquis and ruin the family's reputation!"

The sachet landed at Jiang Sese’s feet.

Jiang Sese was stunned, tears instantly welling up in her eyes as she hurriedly defended herself: "Second Madam, please calm your anger; I have been framed!"

"Framed?" Madam Wang sneered, pointing at Chuntao. "Your good maid just confessed with her own mouth that this sachet was embroidered by you personally, and that you ordered her to find an opportunity to pass it to someone close to Young Marquis Chu! With both human and material evidence present, do you still dare to quibble?!"

Everyone's gaze instantly focused on Chuntao.

Kneeling to the side, Chuntao was so frightened that she kowtowed repeatedly: "It was the cousin miss who ordered this servant to do it... This servant dared not hide it from you, Madam..."

Jiang Sese looked up abruptly at Chuntao, her eyes filled with incredulous shock and streaming with tears: "Chuntao, why are you framing me?! When did I ever order you to do such a thing?!"

"Cousin Miss!" Chuntao, kneeling to the side, became anxious, her face showing a hint of urgency and panic.

Chuntao: "This sachet was clearly made by your own hands, and you ordered me to make sure to give it to someone close to the Young Marquis. Have you forgotten?"

Madam Wang stared suspiciously at Jiang Sese’s face, which was covered in panic and grievance.

Jiang Sese picked up the sachet from the ground, examined it, and suddenly said: "Second Madam, this sachet is not mine; it was made by my other maid, Lü'e!"

Madam Wang was taken aback: "What did you say?!"

Jiang Sese hurriedly said: "Second Madam, please look closely! Lü'e has a habit: she embroiders a tiny character 'E' in the corner of the lining of her embroidery. There is one inside this sachet. My embroidery skills are certainly not this refined, nor would I have this mark!"

Chuntao turned pale with fright upon hearing this and cried out: "You are lying! Cousin Miss, this was clearly embroidered by you! I saw it with my own eyes!"

Madam Wang, half-doubting, signaled to the elderly maid: "Bring it here!"

The maid hurried forward and handed the sachet to Madam Wang.

Madam Wang took a look and indeed saw a tiny character 'E', the stitches so fine and nearly the same color as the fabric that it would be impossible to notice unless one was specifically looking for it.

Could it be... that she had truly wronged Jiang Sese?

Madam Wang’s expression turned extremely ugly.

"Impossible! This is impossible!" Chuntao shrieked, completely losing her composure. "Cousin Miss is lying! This sachet was made by her! How could it have become Lü'e's?! This is impossible!"

"Shut up!" Madam Wang snapped, her irritation growing even deeper.

Madam Wang looked at Jiang Sese with a gloomy face: "Even if this sachet was made by Lü'e, what does that prove? Chuntao identified that you embroidered it yourself and ordered her to pass it to the Young Marquis. How do you explain that?"

Jiang Sese remained calm and composed: "Second Madam, please allow me to explain. I did indeed make a sachet, but it was not for Young Marquis Chu."

"Qingshuang from the Tingsong Courtyard likes the snacks I make. I felt grateful, so I thought I would embroider a simple sachet, fill it with calming incense, and give it to Qingshuang as a token of my thanks. The pattern on that sachet was simple, just a few bamboo leaves, and contained nothing improper. I had just ordered Lü'e to deliver it; by now, she must have just arrived at Tingsong Courtyard or is on her way back."

Jiang Sese added: "If the Second Madam does not believe me, you can immediately send someone to summon Lü'e, or go directly to Tingsong Courtyard to ask Qingshuang, and you will know the truth!"

After speaking, Jiang Sese lowered her head, a slight smile tugging at the corners of her lips.

After Chuntao asked her to make a sachet, she had Lü'e make one as well. Once hers was finished, she had Lü'e take it to Qingshuang.

Then, she gave the sachet Lü'e had made to Chuntao.

This way, the first point of Chuntao’s claim, that it was made by her own hand, was invalidated.

She then seized the opportunity to mention the sachet she had made for Qingshuang.

Since it involved Tingsong Courtyard, Madam Wang could not afford to be careless.

Madam Wang’s expression shifted uncertainly. Jiang Sese’s explanation was logical, cause-and-effect driven, and involved Qingshuang from Tingsong Courtyard.

Qingshuang was the head maid by Xie Jue’s side; if she were truly questioned, the matter would escalate significantly.

Madam Wang thought for a moment and ordered coldly: "Go, bring Lü'e here!"

The maid dared not delay and quickly led people to fetch her.

In just a moment, Lü'e was brought in.

Lü'e was clearly frightened by the late-night commotion, but seeing Jiang Sese kneeling and Chuntao pale, and noticing Madam Wang’s gloomy face, she quickly guessed what was happening.

Lü'e knelt down and bowed: "This servant, Lü'e, pays respects to the Second Madam."

Madam Wang: "Lü'e, your cousin miss says she sent you to Tingsong Courtyard to deliver a sachet she embroidered herself to Qingshuang. Is this true?"

Lü'e understood and immediately replied respectfully: "Returning to Madam, that is true. This servant just returned from Tingsong Courtyard a short while ago; the sachet has already been handed to Qingshuang. Qingshuang even asked me to thank the cousin miss for her kindness on her behalf."

Madam Wang’s heart sank completely.

What Lü'e said matched exactly what Jiang Sese had just stated.

Madam Wang glanced at the maid.

The maid nodded and walked forward with the sachet: "Then... what about this sachet? Did you make this?"

Lü'e looked at it carefully, especially turning to the corner of the lining, and nodded in confusion: "This was indeed made by me. I have a habit of embroidering an 'E' character in the corner of the lining of my embroidery. But this was a sachet I made for the cousin miss; how did it end up here?"

Chuntao, kneeling nearby, looked as if she had been struck by lightning.

She stared at Jiang Sese as if she had seen a ghost, then looked at the sachet, her mind buzzing. She could not comprehend this sudden turn of events: "No... impossible! Cousin Miss, you are lying! This was clearly made by you! I watched you embroider it! How could it be Lü'e's?! You are lying! You are lying!"

Madam Wang felt a surge of rage rush to her head, burning her cheeks.

She had been used as a tool by a maid and had almost wronged someone.

Although Madam Wang detested Jiang Sese, she was even more furious at Chuntao’s audacity!

A maid daring to frame her own mistress.

If she were not severely punished, wouldn't all the servants in the manor run wild?!

Madam Wang was so angry that, without thinking, she snapped: "Good! A treacherous, vicious thing! Someone!"

"Drag this lowly maid out and beat her to death immediately! Let this serve as a warning to all! Let every servant in this house see what happens when you frame your mistress!"

"Madam, have mercy! Madam! This servant is innocent! The cousin miss framed me! It was her, she framed me!" Chuntao wailed in despair, kowtowing desperately for mercy.

But two burly, fierce-looking maids rushed up, ruthlessly gagged her, and dragged her out like a dead dog.

Just as Chuntao was dragged away, Mother Wang hurried in with a shifting, inscrutable expression.
